Chow (ed.), \"\n \"Advances in Hydroscience, 1, 281-442.\"\n ),\n \"niwas_singhal\": (\n \"Niwas, S. and Singhal, D.C. (1981). Estimation of aquifer \"\n \"transmissivity from Dar-Zarrouk parameters in porous media. Journal \"\n \"of Hydrology, 50, 393-399.\"\n ),\n \"langelier\": (\n \"Langelier, W.F. (1936). The analytical control of anti-corrosion \"\n \"water treatment. Journal of the American Water Works Association, 28, \"\n \"1500-1521.\"\n ),\n \"geoboundaries\": (\n \"Runfola, D. et al. (2020). geoBoundaries: A global database of \"\n \"political administrative boundaries. PLoS ONE, 15(4). Licensed CC BY \"\n \"4.0.\"\n ),\n # The wording the CC BY-SA licence prescribes (see THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md\n # and the licence file shipped with the shapefile); the user guide is the\n # report the country map is documented in.\n \"bgs_atlas\": (\n \"British Geological Survey. 2019/2021. Africa Groundwater Atlas \"\n \"Country Hydrogeology Maps. Africa Groundwater Atlas \"\n \"(https://www2.bgs.ac.uk/africagroundwateratlas/index.cfm). Licensed \"\n \"CC BY-SA 4.0.\"\n ),\n \"bgs_guide\": (\n \"\u00d3 Dochartaigh, B. (2021). User Guide Version 1.2: Africa Groundwater \"\n \"Atlas Country Hydrogeology Maps. British Geological Survey Open \"\n \"Report OR/21/063.\"\n ),\n \"usgs_geology\": (\n \"United States Geological Survey (1997). Geologic Map of Africa, \"\n \"Open-File Report 97-470A. Public domain, 1:5,000,000.\"\n ),\n \"salwaco_geology\": (\n \"Ministry of Water Resources and SALWACO (2017). Geology of Sierra \"\n \"Leone. Freetown.\"\n ),\n}\n\n# references relevant to each report type, in a sensible reading order\n_REFERENCES_FOR = {\n \"geophysical\": [\n \"salwaco_geology\", \"usgs_geology\", \"bgs_atlas\", \"bgs_guide\",\n \"geoboundaries\",\n \"niwas_singhal\", \"rwsn_drilling\",\n ],\n \"pumping\": [\"theis\", \"cooper_jacob\", \"hantush\", \"rwsn_drilling\"],\n \"quality\": [\"who\", \"slsb\", \"langelier\"],\n \"completion\": [\"rwsn_drilling\", \"rwsn_cost\", \"who\", \"slsb\"],\n \"handover\": [\"rwsn_drilling\", \"who\", \"slsb\"],\n \"cost\": [\"rwsn_cost\", \"rwsn_drilling\"],\n \"supervision\": [\"rwsn_drilling\", \"rwsn_cost\"],\n}\n\n\ndef references_for(kind: str) -> list[str]:\n \"\"\"Full bibliography entries for a report type.\"\"\"\n return [CITATIONS[key] for key in _REFERENCES_FOR.get(kind, []) if key in CITATIONS]\n\n\n# glossary of abbreviations and terms used across the reports\nGLOSSARY: list[tuple[str, str]] = [\n (\"VES\", \"Vertical electrical sounding, a resistivity depth survey\"),\n (\"AB/2\", \"Half the current-electrode spacing in a Schlumberger array\"),\n (\"ohm-m\", \"Ohm-metre, the unit of electrical resistivity\"),\n (\"ERR\", \"Root-mean-square misfit of the fitted layered model (percent)\"),\n (\"S (Dar-Zarrouk)\", \"Longitudinal conductance, sum of thickness/resistivity (siemens)\"),\n (\"T (Dar-Zarrouk)\", \"Transverse resistance, sum of thickness x resistivity (ohm m2)\"),\n (\"SWL\", \"Static water level, the rest water level before pumping\"),\n (\"DWL\", \"Dynamic water level, the water level during pumping\"),\n (\"T (transmissivity)\", \"Aquifer transmissivity (m2/day)\"),\n (\"S (storativity)\", \"Aquifer storage coefficient (dimensionless)\"),\n (\"m3/h\", \"Cubic metres per hour, a discharge or yield rate\"),\n (\"LSI / RSI\", \"Langelier and Ryznar indices of water corrosivity and scaling\"),\n (\"WQI\", \"Water Quality Index, an aggregate 0-based quality score\"),\n (\"HI\", \"Health Hazard Index, the sum of chronic hazard quotients\"),\n (\"uPVC\", \"Unplasticised polyvinyl chloride, the casing and screen material\"),\n (\"GPS / UTM\", \"Satellite positioning and the Universal Transverse Mercator grid\"),\n (\"WASH\", \"Water, sanitation and hygiene\"),\n (\"RWSN\", \"Rural Water Supply Network\"),\n (\"SALWACO\", \"Sierra Leone Water Company\"),\n (\"WHO\", \"World Health Organization\"),\n (\"SLSB\", \"Sierra Leone Standards Bureau\"),\n]\n"}, "groundwater/reporting/completion.py": {"t": "text", "d": "\"\"\"Borehole completion report generator.\n\nFollows the structure of the contractor completion report example:\nintroduction, methodology, drilling works, borehole log data with the\ndrilling record table, borehole construction and design drawing,\ndevelopment record, pumping test summary, borehole characteristics and\ninstallation block, recommendations and conclusions, and the preparer\nsignature block.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom typing import Any\n\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass, field\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom ..config import Config\nfrom ..design.designer import BoreholeDesign\nfrom ..design.drawing import draw_borehole_design\nfrom ..hydraulics.analysis import PumpingTestAnalysis\nfrom ..hydraulics.analysis import METHOD_LABELS, test_type_text\nfrom ..hydraulics.plots import plot_test_overview\nfrom ..models import DrillingLog\nfrom ..quality.assess import (\n SUITABILITY_PHRASE,\n SUITABILITY_SENTENCE,\n WaterQualityAssessment,\n)\nfrom ..utils import fmt_num, safe_slug\nfrom .citations import GLOSSARY, references_for\nfrom .docx_utils import ReportBuilder\nfrom ..quality.standards import PROVISIONAL_NATIONAL_NOTE, provisional_national_parameters\nfrom .context import add_area_section\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass CompletionReportInputs:\n log: DrillingLog\n design: BoreholeDesign | None = None\n pumping: PumpingTestAnalysis | None = None\n quality: WaterQualityAssessment | None = None\n figures_dir: Path = Path(\".\")\n development_record: list[tuple[str, str, str, str]] = field(default_factory=list)\n # rows of (from time, to time, estimated yield, observation)\n development_note: str = \"\"\n pump_type: str = \"\"\n preparer_name: str = \"\"\n preparer_role: str = \"Technical Manager\"\n preparer_phone: str = \"\"\n #: The certification gate for this report, from\n #: :func:`groundwater.readiness.assess_readiness`. When it is not\n #: certifiable the cover says so; when it is absent nothing is\n #: stamped, so an existing caller is unaffected.\n readiness: Any = None\n\n\ndef _breached_limit(r) -> str:\n \"\"\"The limit the parameter actually breached, matching its status.\n\n Avoids the fixed who_health-first precedence that could display a limit the\n parameter did not exceed (e.g. a WHO health value that was not breached)\n while the remark names the national or aesthetic limit that was.\n \"\"\"\n if r.status == \"exceeds_national\":\n return r.sl_standard or r.who_health or r.who_aesthetic\n if r.status == \"exceeds_aesthetic\":\n return r.who_aesthetic or r.sl_standard or r.who_health\n # exceeds_health (or anything else): prefer the health value, then fall\n # back so microbiological rows whose limit sits in another column still show\n return r.who_health or r.sl_standard or r.who_aesthetic\n\n\ndef _pump_intake(inputs: CompletionReportInputs):\n \"\"\"The one intake depth this report prints.\n\n The design may have moved the yield recommendation's intake out of a\n screen into plain casing; where a design exists its depth is the\n depth, so the drawing, the tables and the summary agree.\n \"\"\"\n design = inputs.design\n if design is not None and design.pump_intake_m is not None:\n return design.pump_intake_m\n yr = inputs.pumping.yield_recommendation if inputs.pumping else None\n return yr.pump_installation_depth_m if yr else None\n\n\ndef _executive_summary(inputs: CompletionReportInputs) -> tuple[list[str], list[str]]:\n \"\"\"Compose the completion executive summary from the drilling and test data.\"\"\"\n log = inputs.log\n community = log.site.community or \"the site\"\n analysis = inputs.pumping\n yr = analysis.yield_recommendation if analysis else None\n quality = inputs.quality\n status = (log.status or \"\").strip()\n\n bits = [\n (\"This report documents the drilling, construction and testing of the \"\n f\"borehole at {community}.\")\n ]\n if log.total_depth_m:\n s = f\"The borehole was drilled to {fmt_num(log.total_depth_m)} m\"\n if log.drilling_method:\n s += f\" by {log.drilling_method}\"\n if status:\n s += f\" and is recorded as {status.lower()}\"\n bits.append(s + \".\")\n if yr is not None and yr.safe_yield_m3_per_h:\n bits.append(\n f\"The recommended safe yield is {fmt_num(yr.safe_yield_m3_per_h)} m3/h \"\n f\"with the pump intake at {fmt_num(_pump_intake(inputs))} m \"\n \"below the top of the casing.\"\n )\n # The pumping report carried the \"treat as indicative\" basis and its\n # warnings; this one printed the same yield without them, and the\n # handover certificate followed it.\n if yr.is_indicative:\n bits.append(yr.confidence_text)\n elif analysis is not None and not analysis.test.has_discharge:\n bits.append(\n \"The pumping test discharge is pending, so the yield figures are not \"\n \"yet final.\"\n )\n if quality is not None:\n # Chosen on the full verdict state, not the health exceedances alone:\n # a national breach or an unevaluable panel used to read as suitable.\n bits.append(SUITABILITY_SENTENCE[quality.verdict_state])\n\n key: list[str] = []\n if log.total_depth_m:\n key.append(\n f\"Borehole depth: {fmt_num(log.total_depth_m)} m\"\n + (f\", {status}.\" if status else \".\")\n )\n if yr is not None and yr.safe_yield_m3_per_h:\n key.append(\n f\"Safe yield: {fmt_num(yr.safe_yield_m3_per_h)} m3/h\"\n + (\" (indicative)\" if yr.is_indicative else \"\") + \".\"\n )\n if quality is not None:\n key.append(\"Water safety: \" + SUITABILITY_PHRASE[quality.verdict_state])\n return [\" \".join(bits)], key\n\n\ndef _record_span(record) -> str:\n \"\"\"``\"The record covers 60 minutes (17:00 to 18:00).\"`` from the times.\"\"\"\n import re\n\n def minutes(text):\n m = re.match(r\"\\s*(\\d{1,2}):(\\d{2})\", str(text or \"\"))\n return int(m.group(1)) * 60 + int(m.group(2)) if m else None\n\n starts = [minutes(r[0]) for r in record if len(r) > 1]\n ends = [minutes(r[1]) for r in record if len(r) > 1]\n starts = [s for s in starts if s is not None]\n ends = [e for e in ends if e is not None]\n if not starts or not ends:\n return \"\"\n total = max(ends) - min(starts)\n if total <= 0:\n return \"\"\n first = min(record, key=lambda r: minutes(r[0]) or 0)[0]\n last = max(record, key=lambda r: minutes(r[1]) or 0)[1]\n hours, mins = divmod(total, 60)\n length = (f\"{hours} h {mins:02d} min\" if hours else f\"{mins} minutes\")\n return f\"The record covers {length} ({first} to {last}).\"\n\n\ndef _design_notes(rb, design) -> None:\n \"\"\"The design's own warnings, in the client document.\n\n A 19 mm annulus and a pump intake inside a screen were flagged on the\n design object and reached no report; the drawing went out clean.\n \"\"\"\n notes = [str(f) for f in design.flags if f.level in (\"warning\", \"error\")]\n if notes:\n rb.paragraph(\"Design notes:\", bold=True)\n rb.bullets(notes)\n\n\ndef build_completion_report(\n inputs: CompletionReportInputs,\n out_path: str | Path,\n config: Config | None = None,\n) -> Path:\n config = config or Config()\n log = inputs.log\n site = log.site\n figures = Path(inputs.figures_dir)\n figures.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n # Qualify figure filenames with the borehole so several reports written\n # into one figures directory cannot silently reuse each other's PNGs (the\n # generation is guarded by an existence check).\n slug = safe_slug(log.borehole_ref or site.community, \"bh\")\n\n rb = ReportBuilder(\n config.style, title=f\"Borehole Completion Report - {site.community}\"\n )\n rb.cover(\n title_lines=[\"BOREHOLE DRILLING AND\", \"PUMP TEST REPORT\"],\n subtitle_lines=[f\"for {site.community}\"],\n details=[\n (\"Submitted to\", site.client),\n (\"Contractor\", site.contractor or \"\"),\n (\"Borehole Ref. No.\", log.borehole_ref or \"\"),\n (\"Completion date\", log.completion_date or \"\"),\n # the driller's word for the hole, not this report's verdict on\n # it: \"Status: Successful\" on a cover stamped PROVISIONAL read\n # as a contradiction\n (\"Status as recorded by the driller\", log.status or \"\"),\n ],\n )\n rb.provisional_stamp(inputs.readiness)\n rb.table_of_contents()\n\n # ---- executive summary ---------------------------------------------------\n exec_paras, exec_key = _executive_summary(inputs)\n rb.executive_summary(exec_paras, exec_key)\n\n # ---- introduction --------------------------------------------------------\n rb.heading(\"1. Introduction\", 1)\n rb.paragraph(\n \"Groundwater can be abstracted from the ground in different ways, and \"\n \"the choice of abstraction method depends on the resources available \"\n \"and the local conditions. Borehole drilling was the recommended \"\n f\"abstraction method for this project at {site.community}, and the \"\n \"work was executed as per the specifications. Details of the \"\n \"activities are presented in this report.\",\n align=\"justify\",\n )\n\n add_area_section(rb, site, figures, config.style,\n heading=\"1.1 Location and setting\")\n\n # ---- methodology -----------------------------------------------------------\n rb.heading(\"2. Methodology\", 1)\n rb.paragraph(\n \"The methodology adopted included reconnaissance, observation of the \"\n \"geological and hydrogeological conditions, assessment of existing \"\n \"boreholes and hand dug wells, drilling, construction, development \"\n \"and test pumping of the borehole.\",\n align=\"justify\",\n )\n\n # ---- drilling ---------------------------------------------------------------\n rb.heading(\"3. Drilling\", 1)\n rb.paragraph(\"The drilling work included the following:\")\n # only the activities the supplied data evidences: a log-only report\n # used to assert casing, gravel pack and development it had no record of\n drilling_works = [\n \"Mobilisation of the drill rig and all necessary equipment.\",\n \"Drilling through all formations for completion of the borehole\"\n + (f\" using the {log.drilling_method} method.\" if log.drilling_method else \".\"),\n ]\n if inputs.design is not None:\n drilling_works += [\n \"Supply and installation of casings (plain and screen).\",\n \"Gravel packing of the annulus.\",\n ]\n if inputs.development_record or inputs.development_note:\n drilling_works.append(\n \"Development of the borehole by surging with compressed air and airlifting.\"\n )\n drilling_works.append(\"Demobilisation.\")\n rb.bullets(drilling_works)\n rb.header_block_table(\n [\n (\"Contractor\", site.contractor or \"\"), (\"Client\", site.client),\n (\"Location\", site.community), (\"Depth of borehole\", fmt_num(log.total_depth_m) + \" m\"),\n (\"Start date\", log.start_date), (\"Completion date\", log.completion_date),\n (\"Drilling method\", log.drilling_method), (\"BH status\", log.status),\n ]\n )\n\n # ---- borehole log -------------------------------------------------------------\n rb.heading(\"4. Borehole Log Data\", 1)\n rows = []\n for iv in log.intervals:\n rows.append(\n [\n f\"{iv.top_m:g}-{iv.bottom_m:g}\",\n fmt_num(iv.thickness_m),\n iv.from_time,\n iv.to_time,\n fmt_num(iv.penetration_rate_m_per_min) if iv.penetration_rate_m_per_min else \"\",\n iv.description,\n f'{iv.bit_diameter_in:g}\"' if iv.bit_diameter_in else \"\",\n ]\n )\n rb.table(\n rows,\n header=[\"Depth (m)\", \"Interval (m)\", \"From\", \"To\",\n \"Penetration rate (m/min)\", \"Sample description\", \"Diameter\"],\n caption=\"Drilling record and formation log.\",\n font_size_pt=8.5,\n )\n strikes = log.water_strikes_m\n if strikes:\n for i, strike in enumerate(strikes, start=1):\n label = [\"First\", \"Second\", \"Third\", \"Fourth\"][i - 1] if i <= 4 else f\"{i}th\"\n rb.paragraph(f\"{label} water strike: {strike:g} m\", bold=True)\n if log.grouting_depth_m:\n rb.paragraph(f\"Grouting: {log.grouting_depth_m:g} m\", bold=True)\n\n # ---- construction / design ---------------------------------------------------\n if inputs.design is not None:\n design = inputs.design\n rb.heading(\"5. Borehole Construction\" + (\"\" if design.as_built else \" Design\"), 1)\n design_fig = figures / f\"borehole_design_{slug}.png\"\n draw_borehole_design(\n inputs.design, log, path=design_fig, style=config.style,\n title=f\"Borehole design - {site.community} ({log.borehole_ref})\",\n header_pairs=[\n (\"Client\", site.client), (\"Contractor\", site.contractor or \"\"),\n (\"Method\", log.drilling_method), (\"Status\", log.status),\n ],\n )\n # The drilling template records the grout depth and, when the crew\n # fills it in, the screens installed; without those the drawing is a\n # design the rules generated from the log, and it used to be\n # captioned \"as-built\" all the same.\n rb.paragraph(design.construction_note, align=\"justify\", italic=True)\n rb.table(\n [[k, v] for k, v in design.summary_rows()],\n header=[\"Item\", \"Detail\"],\n caption=(\"As-built construction summary.\" if design.as_built\n else \"Construction design summary.\"),\n )\n rb.figure(\n design_fig,\n (\"As-built borehole record with lithology and construction columns.\"\n if design.as_built\n else \"Borehole construction design generated from the drilling log, \"\n \"with lithology and construction columns.\"),\n width_cm=13.5,\n )\n if design.design_basis:\n rb.paragraph(\"Design basis:\", bold=True)\n rb.bullets(design.design_basis)\n _design_notes(rb, design)\n\n # ---- development ---------------------------------------------------------------\n section = 6 if inputs.design is not None else 5\n if inputs.development_record or inputs.development_note:\n rb.heading(f\"{section}. Borehole Development Record\", 1)\n if inputs.development_note:\n rb.paragraph(inputs.development_note)\n if inputs.development_record:\n rb.table(\n [list(r) for r in inputs.development_record],\n header=[\"From\", \"To\", \"Estimated yield (m3/h)\", \"Observation\"],\n caption=\"Borehole development by air lifting.\",\n )\n # the recorded duration, from the record itself; a note saying\n # \"two hours\" over a record running 17:00 to 18:00 went out\n # unreconciled\n span = _record_span(inputs.development_record)\n if span:\n rb.paragraph(span)\n section += 1\n\n # ---- pumping test ---------------------------------------------------------------\n if inputs.pumping is not None:\n analysis = inputs.pumping\n test = analysis.test\n rb.heading(f\"{section}. Pumping Test\", 1)\n overview = figures / f\"test_overview_{slug}.png\"\n plot_test_overview(test, path=overview, style=config.style)\n rb.figure(overview, \"Constant discharge test and recovery record.\")\n # the maximum drawdown below is measured at the end of the last step,\n # so the rate quoted beside it has to be that step's, not step 1's\n q = test.steps[-1].discharge_m3_per_h if test.steps else None\n q_label = \"Discharge (final step)\" if len(test.steps) > 1 else \"Discharge\"\n rows = [\n [\"Test type\", test_type_text(test.test_type)],\n [\"Duration\", fmt_num(test.pumping_duration_min) + \" min\" if test.pumping_duration_min else \"\"],\n [q_label, fmt_num(q) + \" m3/h\" if q else \"pending\"],\n [\"Static water level\", fmt_num(test.static_water_level_m) + \" m\"],\n [\"Pump setting during the test\",\n fmt_num(test.pump_setting_m) + \" m\" if test.pump_setting_m else \"not recorded\"],\n [\"Maximum drawdown\", fmt_num(analysis.max_drawdown_m) + \" m\" if analysis.max_drawdown_m else \"\"],\n ]\n if analysis.transmissivity_m2_per_day:\n rows.append([\n \"Transmissivity\",\n fmt_num(analysis.transmissivity_m2_per_day) + \" m2/day\"\n + (f\" ({METHOD_LABELS[analysis.transmissivity_source]})\"\n if analysis.transmissivity_source else \"\"),\n ])\n yr = analysis.yield_recommendation\n if yr and yr.specific_capacity_m3hr_per_m:\n rows.append([\n \"Specific capacity\",\n (f\"{yr.specific_capacity_m3hr_per_m:.2g} m3/h per m \"\n f\"({yr.specific_capacity_basis})\"),\n ])\n if yr and yr.safe_yield_m3_per_h:\n rows.append([\"Safe yield\", yr.yield_range_text])\n rows.append([\n \"Yield confidence\",\n (\"indicative: \" + \"; \".join(yr.confidence_reasons))\n if yr.is_indicative else \"established\",\n ])\n rb.table(rows, header=[\"Item\", \"Value\"], caption=\"Pumping test summary.\")\n section += 1\n\n # ---- characteristics and installation ------------------------------------------\n rb.heading(f\"{section}. Borehole Characteristics and Installation\", 1)\n swl = inputs.pumping.test.static_water_level_m if inputs.pumping else None\n dwl = None\n if inputs.pumping and inputs.pumping.test.steps and swl is not None:\n dwl = float(inputs.pumping.test.steps[-1].water_level_m[-1])\n q = None\n if inputs.pumping and inputs.pumping.test.steps:\n # the same step the dynamic level above came from. Taking the rate\n # from the first step and the level from the last paired step 1's\n # 2.5 m3/h with step 3's 59 m of drawdown - read by the client as the\n # borehole's yield against its drawdown.\n q = inputs.pumping.test.steps[-1].discharge_m3_per_h\n yr = inputs.pumping.yield_recommendation if inputs.pumping else None\n pairs = [\n (\"Borehole depth\", fmt_num(log.total_depth_m) + \" m\"),\n (\"Borehole diameter\", f'{inputs.design.borehole_diameter_in:g}\"' if inputs.design else \"\"),\n (\"Static water level\", fmt_num(swl) + \" m\" if swl is not None else \"\"),\n (\"Dynamic water level at the end of the test\",\n fmt_num(dwl) + \" m\" if dwl is not None else \"\"),\n (\"Drawdown\", fmt_num(dwl - swl) + \" m\" if (dwl is not None and swl is not None) else \"\"),\n # the same unit as every other rate on the page; 2,930 L/h beside\n # 0.97 m3/h read as two different boreholes\n (\"Test discharge\", fmt_num(q) + \" m3/h\" if q else \"pending\"),\n (\"Pump type\", inputs.pump_type),\n (\"Pump setting during the test\",\n fmt_num(inputs.pumping.test.pump_setting_m) + \" m\"\n if inputs.pumping and inputs.pumping.test.pump_setting_m else \"not recorded\"),\n (\"Recommended pump intake\",\n fmt_num(_pump_intake(inputs)) + \" m below the top of the casing\"\n if _pump_intake(inputs) else \"pending\"),\n ]\n rb.header_block_table(pairs)\n section += 1\n\n # ---- water quality (optional) ---------------------------------------------------\n if inputs.quality is not None:\n rb.heading(f\"{section}. Water Quality Summary\", 1)\n rb.paragraph(inputs.quality.verdict, align=\"justify\")\n # every exceedance, national ones included: a national breach is a\n # compliance failure and must appear in the table, not be dropped\n exceed = inputs.quality.all_exceedances\n if exceed:\n rb.table(\n [[r.parameter, fmt_num(r.value), r.unit, _breached_limit(r), r.remark]\n for r in exceed],\n header=[\"Parameter\", \"Value\", \"Unit\", \"Limit\", \"Remark\"],\n caption=\"Parameters above guideline or standard limits.\",\n )\n if provisional_national_parameters():\n rb.paragraph(PROVISIONAL_NATIONAL_NOTE, align=\"justify\", italic=True)\n section += 1\n\n # ---- recommendations ----------------------------------------------------------\n rb.heading(f\"{section}. Recommendations and Conclusions\", 1)\n bullets = []\n yr = inputs.pumping.yield_recommendation if inputs.pumping else None\n successful = (log.status or \"\").lower().startswith(\"success\")\n # \"Successful and sustainable\" is two claims. The log supports the\n # first; only an established yield supports the second, and a\n # 30-minute test inside its casing storage used to be certified as both.\n if yr and yr.safe_yield_m3_per_h and not yr.is_indicative:\n bullets.append(\"The borehole is successful and sustainable when operated as recommended.\")\n elif yr and yr.safe_yield_m3_per_h:\n bullets.append(\n (\"The borehole is recorded as successful. \" if successful else \"\")\n + \"Whether it is sustainable at the recommended rate is indicative, \"\n \"not established: \" + \"; \".join(yr.confidence_reasons)\n + \". Confirm it by a longer test or by monitoring the pumping level \"\n \"in service.\"\n )\n elif successful:\n bullets.append(\n \"The borehole is recorded as successful; no sustainable yield has \"\n \"been established from the pumping test.\"\n )\n if yr and yr.safe_yield_m3_per_h:\n bullets.append(\n f\"The recommended abstraction rate is {fmt_num(yr.safe_yield_m3_per_h)} m3/h \"\n f\"(safety factor {yr.safety_factor:g} applied to the long term yield\"\n + (\", indicative\" if yr.is_indicative else \"\") + \").\"\n )\n if _pump_intake(inputs):\n bullets.append(\n f\"The pump intake is set at {fmt_num(_pump_intake(inputs))} m \"\n \"below the top of the casing\"\n + (\", in plain casing clear of the screens\" if inputs.design else \"\")\n + \".\"\n )\n bullets.append(\n \"The pump should rest for at least one hour in every pumping \"\n \"cycle and the pumping water level should be checked routinely.\"\n )\n elif inputs.pumping is not None and not inputs.pumping.test.has_discharge:\n bullets.append(\n \"The pumping test discharge must be supplied so the yield \"\n \"recommendation can be completed; abstraction figures remain pending.\"\n )\n state = inputs.quality.verdict_state if inputs.quality is not None else None\n if state in (\"health_fail\", \"national_fail\"):\n bullets.append(\n \"Water treatment is required before drinking; see the water \"\n \"quality assessment.\"\n )\n elif state == \"indeterminate\":\n bullets.append(\n \"The water quality results do not yet establish that the supply is \"\n \"safe to drink: \"\n + \"; \".join(inputs.quality.uncertainties)\n + \". Resolve these before the borehole is handed over.\"\n )\n else:\n bullets.append(\n \"Physico-chemical and bacteriological testing should be repeated \"\n \"at least once a year.\"\n )\n rb.bullets(bullets)\n\n # ---- references and glossary -----------------------------------------------\n rb.references(references_for(\"completion\"))\n rb.glossary(GLOSSARY)\n\n rb.signature_block(\n name=inputs.preparer_name or site.supervisor,\n role=inputs.preparer_role,\n phone=inputs.preparer_phone,\n organisation=site.contractor or config.style.organisation,\n )\n return rb.save(out_path)\n"}, "groundwater/reporting/context.py": {"t": "text", "d": "\"\"\"Context map figures shared by the report builders.\n\nWhen a site has coordinates, the reports embed the administrative\nlocation map and the local geological and hydrogeological setting\nmaps, generated once into the report's figures directory.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport math\nimport re\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom ..config import HouseStyle\nfrom ..mapping import (\n area_window,\n plot_admin_map,\n plot_geological_map,\n plot_hydrogeology_map,\n plot_study_area_map,\n)\nfrom ..models import SiteMetadata\n\n\ndef _figures_dir(figures_dir, out_path) -> Path:\n \"\"\"Where a report's figures belong.\n\n A default of ``Path(\".\")`` meant a report built without one dropped its\n PNGs into whatever directory the process was started in - a user's home,\n a CI checkout, the repository root. The directory holding the document is\n always known by the time anything is drawn, and is where someone looking\n for the figures would look.\n \"\"\"\n if figures_dir is not None:\n figures = Path(figures_dir)\n else:\n figures = Path(out_path).parent\n figures.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n return figures\n\n\ndef _map_key(window) -> str:\n \"\"\"The token in a context map's file name.\n\n A site with a GPS fix is keyed by its position, so two sites in one\n project keep their own maps rather than overwriting each other. A site\n without one is keyed by the area the map covers - \"western_area_rural_\n district\" - and not by that area's centroid: the centroid is a\n floating-point property of the boundary layer, and every rebuild of\n that layer moved it by a few metres, which left a stale twin of every\n area map beside the current one with nothing in either name to say\n which the report used.\n \"\"\"\n if window.exact:\n return f\"{window.lat:.4f}_{abs(window.lon):.4f}\".replace(\".\", \"p\")\n slug = re.sub(r\"[^a-z0-9]+\", \"_\", window.label.lower()).strip(\"_\")\n return slug or \"area\"\n\n\n#: A study-area map of a site with a GPS fix spans this much either side\n#: of it unless the overlay points need more: at 10 km the village, the\n#: soundings and the recommended point are told apart, which at the old\n#: fixed 40 km (an 80 km window) they never were.\nSTUDY_AREA_RADIUS_KM = 10.0\n\n\ndef study_area_radius_km(site: SiteMetadata | None, points: list[dict] | None,\n ceiling_km: float = 40.0) -> float:\n \"\"\"The half-width of the study-area map, from what has to fit on it.\"\"\"\n lats, lons = [], []\n if site is not None and site.latlon is not None:\n lats.append(site.latlon[0])\n lons.append(site.latlon[1])\n for point in points or []:\n if point.get(\"lat\") is not None and point.get(\"lon\") is not None:\n lats.append(float(point[\"lat\"]))\n lons.append(float(point[\"lon\"]))\n if len(lats) < 2:\n return min(STUDY_AREA_RADIUS_KM, ceiling_km)\n # the map is centred on the site (area_window), so what has to fit is\n # the farthest point from it, not half the spread between the points\n if site is not None and site.latlon is not None:\n centre_lat, centre_lon = site.latlon\n else:\n centre_lat, centre_lon = sum(lats) / len(lats), sum(lons) / len(lons)\n cos_lat = math.cos(math.radians(centre_lat))\n farthest = max(\n math.hypot((lat - centre_lat) * 111.32, (lon - centre_lon) * 111.32 * cos_lat)\n for lat, lon in zip(lats, lons, strict=True)\n )\n # the farthest point with a quarter of the frame to spare beyond it\n needed = farthest * 1.25 + 1.0\n return float(min(max(STUDY_AREA_RADIUS_KM, needed), ceiling_km))\n\n\ndef context_map_figures(\n site: SiteMetadata | None,\n figures_dir: str | Path,\n style: HouseStyle | None = None,\n local_radius_km: float = 40.0,\n points: list[dict] | None = None,\n mark_site: bool = True,\n) -> dict[str, Path]:\n \"\"\"Generate the context maps for a site.\n\n A GPS fix centres the local maps on the point. Without one they are\n centred on the recorded chiefdom, or failing that the district, and\n say so in their titles - the area is still worth mapping, and a\n report about a place that shows no map of it is worse than one whose\n map is a district rather than a point. Only a project that records\n neither a position nor an area gets nothing.\n\n Returns paths keyed ``study_area``, ``admin``, ``geology`` and\n ``hydrogeology``. :func:`groundwater.mapping.area_window` gives the\n window they cover. The maps are redrawn on every build. They are\n cheap, and a map that was left on disk by an earlier run is a map of\n what the project used to say: reusing it is the one way this function\n can be wrong.\n\n ``study_area`` is the one a reader needs first and the one these\n reports had no equivalent of: the national location map answers\n \"which district\", and the geology and aquifer maps answer \"what is\n the ground\", but nothing showed the area itself at a scale where the\n distance from the borehole to the next village could be read off a\n scale bar.\n\n ``points`` are overlays for the study area map, as dicts\n ``{lat, lon, label, kind}``: the survey points, and any water points\n already found nearby.\n \"\"\"\n if site is None:\n return {}\n window = area_window(site, local_radius_km)\n if window is None:\n return {}\n figures = Path(figures_dir)\n figures.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n token = _map_key(window)\n out: dict[str, Path] = {}\n study = figures / f\"study_area_map_{token}.png\"\n try:\n # a site with a fix is mapped at the scale its points need; an\n # area without one is mapped at the area's own size by area_window\n plot_study_area_map(site, path=study, style=style,\n radius_km=study_area_radius_km(\n site, points, ceiling_km=min(local_radius_km, 40.0)),\n points=points or [], mark_site=mark_site)\n out[\"study_area\"] = study\n except ValueError:\n # area_window found a centre, so this should not happen; if the\n # boundary layers cannot frame it the rest of the maps are still\n # worth having, and a missing figure is better than a failed report\n pass\n admin = figures / f\"admin_map_{token}.png\"\n plot_admin_map(site, path=admin, style=style)\n out[\"admin\"] = admin\n geology = figures / f\"geology_local_map_{token}.png\"\n plot_geological_map(site, path=geology, style=style,\n radius_km=local_radius_km)\n out[\"geology\"] = geology\n hydro = figures / f\"hydro_local_map_{token}.png\"\n plot_hydrogeology_map(site, path=hydro, style=style,\n radius_km=local_radius_km)\n out[\"hydrogeology\"] = hydro\n return out\n\n\ndef area_map_note(site: SiteMetadata | None) -> str:\n \"\"\"One sentence placing the site, for the paragraph above the map.\"\"\"\n if site is None:\n return \"No site metadata was supplied with this report.\"\n where = \", \".join(\n part for part in (site.community, site.chiefdom and f\"{site.chiefdom} chiefdom\",\n site.district and f\"{site.district} district\")\n if part\n )\n if site.latlon is None:\n window = area_window(site)\n if window is None:\n return (\n (f\"The site is recorded as {where}. \" if where else \"\")\n + \"Neither a GPS position nor an administrative area is \"\n \"recorded for it, so no map of the area can be drawn. A \"\n \"borehole that cannot be found again on the ground cannot be \"\n \"revisited or maintained: record the position on the field \"\n \"sheet and reissue this report.\"\n )\n return (\n (f\"The site is recorded as {where}. \" if where else \"\")\n + f\"No GPS position is recorded for it, so the maps below cover \"\n f\"{window.label} rather than the borehole itself and carry no \"\n \"site marker. Record the position on the field sheet and reissue \"\n \"this report: a borehole that cannot be found again on the ground \"\n \"cannot be revisited or maintained.\"\n )\n lat, lon = site.latlon\n ns = \"N\" if lat >= 0 else \"S\"\n ew = \"E\" if lon >= 0 else \"W\"\n return (\n (f\"The site is at {where}, \" if where else \"The site is at \")\n + f\"{abs(lat):.5f} {ns}, {abs(lon):.5f} {ew}.\"\n )\n\n\ndef add_area_section(\n rb,\n site: SiteMetadata | None,\n figures_dir: str | Path,\n style: HouseStyle | None = None,\n *,\n heading: str | None = \"Location and setting\",\n level: int = 2,\n detail: bool = False,\n local_radius_km: float = 40.0,\n points: list[dict] | None = None,\n) -> dict[str, Path]:\n \"\"\"Put a map of the area into a report.\n\n Every report carries one, because every report is about a place and\n the reader has to be able to find it. ``detail`` adds the aquifer and\n geological setting maps as well as the locator; the geophysical and\n handover reports want those, a payment certificate does not.\n\n Returns the figure paths, so a caller that wants to say more about\n them can. Without coordinates nothing is drawn and the paragraph\n says why.\n \"\"\"\n if heading:\n rb.heading(heading, level)\n rb.paragraph(area_map_note(site), align=\"justify\")\n maps = context_map_figures(site, figures_dir, style,\n local_radius_km=local_radius_km,\n points=points)\n if not maps:\n return {}\n window = area_window(site, local_radius_km)\n where = (window.label if window is not None\n else ((site.community if site is not None else \"\") or \"the site\"))\n if \"study_area\" in maps:\n rb.figure(\n maps[\"study_area\"],\n f\"Study area at {where}, with its location in Sierra Leone \"\n \"inset. Boundaries from geoBoundaries (CC BY 4.0).\",\n width_cm=14.0,\n )\n rb.figure(\n maps[\"admin\"],\n f\"Location of {where}. Boundaries from geoBoundaries (CC BY 4.0).\",\n width_cm=14.0,\n )\n if detail:\n rb.figure(\n maps[\"hydrogeology\"],\n \"Aquifer type and productivity around the site, from the BGS \"\n \"Africa Groundwater Atlas country map (CC BY-SA 4.0).\",\n width_cm=14.0,\n )\n rb.figure(\n maps[\"geology\"],\n \"Geological setting around the site, from the USGS Geologic Map \"\n \"of Africa (1:5,000,000).\",\n width_cm=14.0,\n )\n return maps\n"}, "groundwater/reporting/costing.py": {"t": "text", "d": "\"\"\"Borehole cost estimate report generator.\n\nA short client-ready document: the basis of the estimate, the bill of\nquantities, the cost and price roll-up and the assumptions, following\nthe RWSN Cost-Effective Boreholes methodology (cost first, price\nseparately, both breakdowns shown).\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom typing import Any\n\nfrom ..config import Config\nfrom ..costing.model import CostEstimate\nfrom ..costing.plots import plot_cost_breakdown\nfrom ..costing.plots import plot_programme_gantt\nfrom ..costing.programme import ProgrammeEstimate\nfrom ..models import SiteMetadata\nfrom ..utils import fmt_num\nfrom .citations import GLOSSARY, references_for\nfrom .context import _figures_dir, add_area_section\nfrom .docx_utils import ReportBuilder\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass CostReportInputs:\n estimate: CostEstimate\n site: SiteMetadata | None = None\n #: Left unset, the figures go beside the document rather than into\n #: whatever directory the process happens to be running in.\n figures_dir: Path | None = None\n prepared_by: str = \"\"\n #: The package roll-up from\n #: :func:`groundwater.costing.estimate_programme_cost`. A programme is\n #: budgeted per successful borehole, and the number that has to be\n #: budgeted for carries the dry attempts - a figure that existed in the\n #: toolkit and appeared in no document it wrote.\n programme: ProgrammeEstimate | None = None\n #: :class:`~groundwater.readiness.Readiness` for this report, from\n #: :func:`groundwater.readiness.assess_readiness`. When it is not\n #: certifiable the cover carries a PROVISIONAL stamp listing why.\n readiness: Any = None\n\n\ndef build_cost_report(\n inputs: CostReportInputs,\n out_path: str | Path,\n config: Config | None = None,\n) -> Path:\n config = config or Config()\n estimate = inputs.estimate\n site = inputs.site or SiteMetadata()\n figures = _figures_dir(inputs.figures_dir, out_path)\n\n rb = ReportBuilder(\n config.style,\n title=f\"Cost Estimate - {site.community or 'Borehole'}\",\n )\n rb.cover(\n title_lines=[\"BOREHOLE COST ESTIMATE\"],\n subtitle_lines=[\n f\"at {site.community}\" + (f\", {site.district} District\" if site.district else \"\")\n if site.community\n else \"Drilled Water Well Construction\",\n ],\n details=[\n (\"Client\", site.client),\n (\"Project\", site.project),\n (\"Prepared by\", inputs.prepared_by or site.contractor),\n (\"Date\", site.date),\n ],\n )\n rb.provisional_stamp(inputs.readiness)\n rb.table_of_contents()\n\n # ---- 1 method ------------------------------------------------------\n rb.heading(\"1. Method\", 1)\n rb.paragraph(\n \"The estimate follows the Rural Water Supply Network (RWSN) \"\n \"Cost-Effective Boreholes methodology. Every line item carries a \"\n \"construction stage and a resource category, so the total can be \"\n \"broken down both ways. The estimate first establishes the cost \"\n \"of the works; the contract price is then derived by adding \"\n \"overheads and a margin, and a separate contingency allowance is \"\n \"shown for budget planning. Keeping cost and price apart follows \"\n \"the RWSN guidance for sustainable drilling enterprises.\",\n align=\"justify\",\n )\n rb.paragraph(\n \"The unit rates are indicative values held in an editable \"\n \"catalogue and must be confirmed against current local prices \"\n \"before the estimate is used for contracting.\",\n align=\"justify\",\n )\n\n add_area_section(rb, site, figures, config.style,\n heading=\"1.1 Location and setting\")\n\n # ---- 2 basis -------------------------------------------------------\n rb.heading(\"2. Basis of the Estimate\", 1)\n quantities = inputs.estimate.inputs\n rb.table(\n [\n [\"Total depth\", fmt_num(quantities.total_depth_m) + \" m\"],\n [\"Overburden / hard rock\",\n f\"{fmt_num(quantities.overburden_m)} m / {fmt_num(quantities.bedrock_m)} m\"],\n [\"Plain casing / screen\",\n (f\"{fmt_num(quantities.casing_m)} m / {fmt_num(quantities.screen_m)} m \"\n f\"({quantities.casing_diameter_in:g} inch)\")],\n [\"Drilled diameter\", f\"{quantities.borehole_diameter_in:g} inch\"],\n [\"Gravel packed interval\", fmt_num(quantities.gravel_interval_m) + \" m\"],\n [\"Mobilisation distance (one way)\",\n fmt_num(quantities.mobilisation_distance_km) + \" km\"],\n [\"Crew time on site\", fmt_num(quantities.crew_days) + \" days\"],\n [\"Development / test pumping\",\n (f\"{fmt_num(quantities.development_hours)} h / \"\n f\"{fmt_num(quantities.test_pumping_hours)} h\")],\n [\"Water quality samples\", fmt_num(quantities.wq_samples)],\n [\"Handpumps included\", fmt_num(quantities.handpumps)],\n ],\n header=[\"Quantity driver\", \"Value\"],\n caption=\"Quantities driving the bill of quantities.\",\n )\n if estimate.assumptions:\n rb.paragraph(\"Assumptions applied where inputs were not supplied:\")\n rb.bullets(estimate.assumptions)\n\n # ---- 3 bill of quantities -------------------------------------------\n rb.heading(\"3. Bill of Quantities\", 1)\n rows = [\n [\n r[\"Code\"],\n r[\"Item\"],\n r[\"Unit\"],\n fmt_num(r[\"Quantity\"]),\n f\"{r['Rate (USD)']:,.2f}\",\n f\"{r['Amount (USD)']:,.2f}\",\n ]\n for r in estimate.boq_rows()\n ]\n rb.table(\n rows,\n header=[\"Code\", \"Item\", \"Unit\", \"Qty\", \"Rate (USD)\", \"Amount (USD)\"],\n caption=\"Bill of quantities at the catalogue unit rates.\",\n )\n\n # ---- 4 summary -------------------------------------------------------\n rb.heading(\"4. Cost Summary\", 1)\n rb.table(\n [list(row) for row in estimate.summary_rows()],\n header=[\"Item\", \"USD\", \"SLE\"],\n caption=(\n \"Cost and price roll-up. Local amounts use an exchange rate \"\n f\"of {estimate.exchange_rate_sle_per_usd:g} SLE per USD.\"\n ),\n )\n fig_path = figures / \"cost_breakdown.png\"\n plot_cost_breakdown(estimate, fig_path, config.style)\n rb.figure(fig_path, \"Direct works cost by stage and by resource category.\")\n\n # ---- 5 programme ------------------------------------------------------\n section = 5\n if inputs.programme is not None:\n programme = inputs.programme\n rb.heading(f\"{section}. Programme of Works\", 1)\n rb.paragraph(\n f\"{programme.n_successful} successful \"\n + (\"borehole\" if programme.n_successful == 1 else \"boreholes\")\n + f\" at a siting success rate of {programme.success_rate_percent:g}% \"\n f\"means budgeting for {programme.n_attempted} \"\n + (\"attempt\" if programme.n_attempted == 1 else \"attempts\")\n + \". A programme budget that counts only the holes that find \"\n \"water runs out before the last village has any.\",\n align=\"justify\",\n )\n rb.table(\n [list(row) for row in programme.summary_rows()],\n header=[\"Item\", \"USD\", \"SLE\"],\n caption=\"Programme roll-up, carrying the expected dry attempts.\",\n )\n gantt = figures / \"programme_gantt.png\"\n plot_programme_gantt(programme, gantt, config.style)\n rb.figure(gantt, \"Indicative programme of works.\")\n if programme.assumptions:\n rb.paragraph(\"Assumptions:\", bold=True)\n rb.bullets([str(a) for a in programme.assumptions])\n section += 1\n\n # ---- notes ------------------------------------------------------------\n rb.heading(f\"{section}. Notes and Exclusions\", 1)\n notes = [\n (\"Unit rates are indicative and must be confirmed against local \"\n \"supplier and contractor quotations before award.\"),\n (\"The estimate covers one production borehole; failed or abandoned \"\n \"holes, standby time and exceptional ground conditions are not \"\n \"included and should be covered by the contract conditions.\"),\n (\"Land access, community mobilisation and post-construction \"\n \"monitoring are excluded.\"),\n ]\n for flag in estimate.flags:\n notes.append(str(flag.message))\n rb.bullets(notes)\n\n rb.references(references_for(\"cost\"))\n rb.glossary(GLOSSARY)\n\n return rb.save(out_path)\n"}, "groundwater/reporting/docx_utils.py": {"t": "text", "d": "\"\"\"House-styled .docx building blocks.\n\nWraps python-docx with the toolkit's house style: white background,\none accent colour, clean tables, automatic figure and table numbering,\na real table of contents field, page numbers, and a reproducible save\n(fixed zip timestamps so re-running on the same data gives an\nidentical file).\n\nHouse language rules are enforced here: em and en dashes are replaced\nwith plain hyphens and a lint helper flags contractions so template\ntext stays in plain professional English.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nimport zipfile\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport docx\nfrom docx.enum.table import WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT\nfrom docx.enum.text import WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH, WD_BREAK\nfrom docx.oxml import OxmlElement\nfrom docx.oxml.ns import qn\nfrom docx.shared import Cm, Pt, RGBColor\n\nfrom ..config import HouseStyle\n\n_CONTRACTION_RE = re.compile(\n r\"\\b(?:can't|won't|don't|doesn't|didn't|isn't|aren't|wasn't|weren't|\"\n r\"hasn't|haven't|hadn't|shouldn't|couldn't|wouldn't|it's|that's|there's|\"\n r\"what's|let's|they're|we're|you're|i'm|he's|she's|who's|it'll|we'll|\"\n r\"you'll|they'll|i've|we've|you've|they've)\\b\",\n re.IGNORECASE,\n)\n\n\ndef lint_text(text: str) -> list[str]:\n \"\"\"Return house style violations in a piece of report text.\"\"\"\n problems = []\n if \"\u2014\" in text or \"\u2013\" in text:\n problems.append(\"em or en dash present\")\n for match in _CONTRACTION_RE.finditer(text):\n problems.append(f\"contraction '{match.group(0)}'\")\n return problems\n\n\ndef _clean(text) -> str:\n \"\"\"Apply the house language rules to outgoing text.\n\n ``None`` is an empty cell, not the word \"None\".\n \"\"\"\n if text is None:\n return \"\"\n return str(text).replace(\"\u2014\", \" - \").replace(\"\u2013\", \"-\")\n\n\ndef _hex_to_rgb(color: str) -> RGBColor:\n color = color.lstrip(\"#\")\n return RGBColor(int(color[0:2], 16), int(color[2:4], 16), int(color[4:6], 16))\n\n\nclass ReportBuilder:\n \"\"\"Assemble a styled report document section by section.\"\"\"\n\n def __init__(self, style: HouseStyle | None = None, title: str = \"Report\"):\n self.style = style or HouseStyle()\n self.doc = docx.Document()\n self.title = title\n self._figure_no = 0\n self._table_no = 0\n # every heading, in order, for the table of contents\n self._headings: list[tuple[int, str]] = []\n self._setup_styles()\n self._setup_page()\n\n # ------------------------------------------------------------------\n # set-up\n # ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n def _setup_styles(self) -> None:\n accent = _hex_to_rgb(self.style.accent_color)\n normal = self.doc.styles[\"Normal\"]\n normal.font.name = self.style.font_name\n normal.font.size = Pt(self.style.base_font_size_pt)\n normal.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(6)\n normal.paragraph_format.line_spacing = 1.15\n\n for level, size, bold in ((1, 14, True), (2, 12, True), (3, 11, True)):\n h = self.doc.styles[f\"Heading {level}\"]\n h.font.name = self.style.font_name\n h.font.size = Pt(size)\n h.font.bold = bold\n h.font.color.rgb = accent\n h.paragraph_format.space_before = Pt(12 if level == 1 else 8)\n h.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(6)\n h.paragraph_format.keep_with_next = True\n\n caption = self.doc.styles[\"Caption\"] if \"Caption\" in [s.name for s in self.doc.styles] else None\n if caption is not None:\n caption.font.name = self.style.font_name\n caption.font.size = Pt(9)\n caption.font.bold = True\n caption.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(0x33, 0x33, 0x33)\n\n def _setup_page(self) -> None:\n section = self.doc.sections[0]\n section.page_width = Cm(21.0)\n section.page_height = Cm(29.7)\n for side in (\"top\", \"bottom\", \"left\", \"right\"):\n setattr(section, f\"{side}_margin\", Cm(2.5))\n self._add_page_numbers(section)\n\n def _add_page_numbers(self, section) -> None:\n footer_para = section.footer.paragraphs[0]\n footer_para.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER\n run = footer_para.add_run()\n for element, _text in ((\"begin\", None), (None, \"PAGE\"), (\"end\", None)):\n if element:\n fld = OxmlElement(\"w:fldChar\")\n fld.set(qn(\"w:fldCharType\"), element)\n run._r.append(fld)\n else:\n instr = OxmlElement(\"w:instrText\")\n instr.set(qn(\"xml:space\"), \"preserve\")\n instr.text = \" PAGE \"\n run._r.append(instr)\n run.font.size = Pt(9)\n\n # ------------------------------------------------------------------\n # content\n # ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n def cover(\n self,\n title_lines: list[str],\n subtitle_lines: list[str] | None = None,\n details: list[tuple[str, str]] | None = None,\n ) -> None:\n \"\"\"Simple clean cover: organisation, title block, detail lines.\"\"\"\n if self.style.logo_path and Path(self.style.logo_path).exists():\n p = self.doc.add_paragraph()\n p.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER\n p.add_run().add_picture(self.style.logo_path, width=Cm(4.5))\n if self.style.organisation:\n p = self.doc.add_paragraph()\n p.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER\n run = p.add_run(_clean(self.style.organisation))\n run.font.size = Pt(14)\n run.font.bold = True\n run.font.color.rgb = _hex_to_rgb(self.style.accent_color)\n if self.style.organisation_details:\n p2 = self.doc.add_paragraph()\n p2.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER\n r2 = p2.add_run(_clean(self.style.organisation_details))\n r2.font.size = Pt(9)\n for _ in range(4):\n self.doc.add_paragraph()\n for line in title_lines:\n p = self.doc.add_paragraph()\n p.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER\n run = p.add_run(_clean(line))\n run.font.size = Pt(20)\n run.font.bold = True\n run.font.color.rgb = _hex_to_rgb(self.style.accent_color)\n for line in subtitle_lines or []:\n p = self.doc.add_paragraph()\n p.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER\n run = p.add_run(_clean(line))\n run.font.size = Pt(13)\n # a detail nobody filled in is left off: \"Project:\" and \"Date:\"\n # with nothing after them were two blank lines on the handover cover\n details = [(label, value) for label, value in (details or [])\n if value is not None and str(value).strip()]\n if details:\n for _ in range(3):\n self.doc.add_paragraph()\n for label, value in details:\n p = self.doc.add_paragraph()\n p.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER\n run = p.add_run(f\"{_clean(label)}: \")\n run.font.bold = True\n p.add_run(_clean(str(value)))\n self.page_break()\n\n def provisional_stamp(self, readiness) -> None:\n \"\"\"Say on the cover that this document is not a certification.\n\n A report is what a borehole is handed over on, so one built from\n incomplete evidence must not be indistinguishable from one built\n from complete evidence. A ready project gets no stamp at all; every\n other project gets this, naming exactly what is outstanding or what\n was overridden and by whom, in the document itself rather than in a\n console message nobody keeps.\n \"\"\"\n if readiness is None or readiness.is_certifiable:\n return\n # remembered for the executive summary, which used to open with an\n # unqualified verdict two pages after the stamp\n self._readiness = readiness\n overridden = readiness.state == \"ready_with_overrides\"\n title = (\"ISSUED ON OVERRIDE - NOT A CERTIFICATION\" if overridden\n else \"PROVISIONAL - NOT FOR CERTIFICATION\")\n para = self.doc.add_paragraph()\n para.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER\n run = para.add_run(_clean(title))\n run.font.size = Pt(13)\n run.font.bold = True\n run.font.color.rgb = _hex_to_rgb(\"#B23A2E\")\n\n lead = (\n \"This report was issued although the following requirements were \"\n \"not met. The reason recorded for each is given.\"\n if overridden else\n \"This report rests on incomplete results. The following \"\n \"requirements for certification are outstanding.\"\n )\n self.paragraph(lead, italic=True, align=\"justify\")\n lines = []\n for req in readiness.overridden:\n who = f\" ({req.override_by})\" if req.override_by else \"\"\n reason = req.override_reason or \"no reason recorded\"\n lines.append(f\"{req.title}: {req.detail} Overridden{who}: {reason}\")\n for req in readiness.unmet:\n lines.append(f\"{req.title}: {req.detail}\")\n if lines:\n self.bullets(lines)\n self.page_break()\n\n def table_of_contents(self) -> None:\n \"\"\"A table of contents that reads before Word has updated anything.\n\n python-docx cannot lay out pages, so the page numbers come from Word\n updating the field (the document asks it to on opening). The field's\n cached result, which is what every other viewer and every text\n extraction shows, used to be the sentence \"Right-click and choose\n Update Field\": it is now the list of headings, filled in when the\n report is saved.\n \"\"\"\n self.heading(\"Table of Contents\", level=1, numbered=False)\n para = self.doc.add_paragraph()\n run = para.add_run()\n fld_begin = OxmlElement(\"w:fldChar\")\n fld_begin.set(qn(\"w:fldCharType\"), \"begin\")\n instr = OxmlElement(\"w:instrText\")\n instr.set(qn(\"xml:space\"), \"preserve\")\n instr.text = 'TOC \\\\o \"1-3\" \\\\h \\\\z \\\\u'\n fld_sep = OxmlElement(\"w:fldChar\")\n fld_sep.set(qn(\"w:fldCharType\"), \"separate\")\n placeholder = OxmlElement(\"w:t\")\n placeholder.set(qn(\"xml:space\"), \"preserve\")\n placeholder.text = \"\"\n fld_end = OxmlElement(\"w:fldChar\")\n fld_end.set(qn(\"w:fldCharType\"), \"end\")\n for el in (fld_begin, instr, fld_sep, placeholder, fld_end):\n run._r.append(el)\n self._toc_run = run\n self._toc_placeholder = placeholder\n self.page_break()\n\n def _fill_table_of_contents(self) -> None:\n \"\"\"Write the headings into the field's cached result and ask Word to\n update the field on opening, so the page numbers appear there.\"\"\"\n placeholder = getattr(self, \"_toc_placeholder\", None)\n if placeholder is None:\n return\n # one line per heading, indented by level, as the cached result;\n # the breaks go inside the field result, before the placeholder,\n # or the headings run into one line\n first = True\n for level, text in self._headings:\n if not first:\n placeholder.addprevious(OxmlElement(\"w:br\"))\n first = False\n t = OxmlElement(\"w:t\")\n t.set(qn(\"xml:space\"), \"preserve\")\n t.text = (\" \" * (level - 1)) + text\n placeholder.addprevious(t)\n placeholder.getparent().remove(placeholder)\n settings = self.doc.settings.element\n if settings.find(qn(\"w:updateFields\")) is None:\n update = OxmlElement(\"w:updateFields\")\n update.set(qn(\"w:val\"), \"true\")\n settings.append(update)\n\n def executive_summary(\n self, paragraphs: list[str], key_findings: list[str] | None = None\n ) -> None:\n \"\"\"A short verdict block placed at the very top of a report.\n\n Composed from figures the report already computes, so a ministry\n engineer or programme manager gets the yield, water safety and the\n single next action before any detail. ``key_findings`` renders as a\n tight bullet list under a bold label.\n \"\"\"\n self.heading(\"Executive Summary\", level=1, numbered=False)\n readiness = getattr(self, \"_readiness\", None)\n if readiness is not None and not readiness.is_certifiable:\n # the summary is qualified the way the cover is: a reader who\n # starts here is told what the figures below do not yet rest on\n outstanding = [r.title for r in readiness.unmet]\n overridden = [r.title for r in getattr(readiness, \"overridden\", [])]\n what = []\n if outstanding:\n what.append(\"outstanding: \" + \", \".join(outstanding))\n if overridden:\n what.append(\"issued on override: \" + \", \".join(overridden))\n self.paragraph(\n \"This report is provisional and not a certification (\"\n + \"; \".join(what) + \"). The findings below are those the \"\n \"supplied records support; the cover says what is missing.\",\n bold=True, align=\"justify\",\n )\n for text in paragraphs:\n if not text:\n continue\n self.paragraph(text, align=\"justify\")\n if key_findings:\n self.paragraph(\"Key findings:\", bold=True)\n self.bullets([k for k in key_findings if k])\n self.page_break()\n\n def heading(self, text: str, level: int = 1, numbered: bool = True) -> None:\n self.doc.add_heading(_clean(text), level=level)\n if numbered and level <= 3:\n self._headings.append((level, _clean(text)))\n\n def paragraph(self, text: str, bold: bool = False, italic: bool = False,\n align: str | None = None, size_pt: float | None = None):\n p = self.doc.add_paragraph()\n run = p.add_run(_clean(text))\n run.font.bold = bold\n run.font.italic = italic\n if size_pt is not None:\n run.font.size = Pt(size_pt)\n if align == \"center\":\n p.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER\n elif align == \"justify\":\n p.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.JUSTIFY\n return p\n\n def bullets(self, items: list[str]) -> None:\n for item in items:\n self.doc.add_paragraph(_clean(item), style=\"List Bullet\")\n\n def references(self, entries: list[str]) -> None:\n \"\"\"A References section with hanging-indent bibliography entries.\"\"\"\n if not entries:\n return\n self.heading(\"References\", level=1, numbered=False)\n for entry in entries:\n para = self.doc.add_paragraph(_clean(entry))\n para.paragraph_format.left_indent = Cm(0.8)\n para.paragraph_format.first_line_indent = Cm(-0.8)\n para.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(4)\n\n def glossary(self, terms: list[tuple[str, str]]) -> None:\n \"\"\"A two-column glossary and abbreviations table.\"\"\"\n if not terms:\n return\n self.heading(\"Glossary and Abbreviations\", level=1, numbered=False)\n self.table(\n [[term, meaning] for term, meaning in terms],\n header=[\"Term\", \"Meaning\"],\n col_widths_cm=[3.5, 12.0],\n font_size_pt=9.0,\n )\n\n def figure(self, image_path: str | Path, caption: str, width_cm: float = 15.0) -> int:\n \"\"\"Insert an image with an automatic 'Figure N.' caption.\n\n Returns the figure number so body text can reference it.\n \"\"\"\n self._figure_no += 1\n p = self.doc.add_paragraph()\n p.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER\n p.add_run().add_picture(str(image_path), width=Cm(width_cm))\n cap = self._caption_paragraph()\n run = cap.add_run(f\"Figure {self._figure_no}. {_clean(caption)}\")\n run.font.size = Pt(9)\n run.font.bold = True\n cap.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER\n return self._figure_no\n\n def _caption_paragraph(self):\n \"\"\"A paragraph in Word's Caption style, so a list of figures and a\n list of tables can be built from the captions; they used to be plain\n bold paragraphs.\"\"\"\n try:\n return self.doc.add_paragraph(style=\"Caption\")\n except KeyError:\n return self.doc.add_paragraph()\n\n @property\n def next_figure_number(self) -> int:\n return self._figure_no + 1\n\n @property\n def next_table_number(self) -> int:\n return self._table_no + 1\n\n def table(\n self,\n rows: list[list],\n header: list[str] | None = None,\n caption: str | None = None,\n col_widths_cm: list[float] | None = None,\n font_size_pt: float = 9.5,\n ) -> int:\n \"\"\"Insert a styled table; returns the table number.\n\n The caption goes above the table (report convention). Cell\n values may contain newlines for stacked layer entries.\n \"\"\"\n self._table_no += 1\n if caption:\n cap = self._caption_paragraph()\n run = cap.add_run(f\"Table {self._table_no}. {_clean(caption)}\")\n run.font.size = Pt(9)\n run.font.bold = True\n # an empty table with no header used to crash the whole build on\n # max() of nothing; it is one row saying there is nothing to show\n if not rows and not header:\n rows = [[\"(no entries)\"]]\n n_cols = len(header) if header else max(len(r) for r in rows)\n table = self.doc.add_table(rows=0, cols=n_cols)\n table.alignment = WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT.CENTER\n table.style = \"Table Grid\"\n accent = self.style.accent_color.lstrip(\"#\")\n\n if header:\n cells = table.add_row().cells\n for i, text in enumerate(header):\n cells[i].text = \"\"\n para = cells[i].paragraphs[0]\n run = para.add_run(_clean(str(text)))\n run.font.bold = True\n run.font.size = Pt(font_size_pt)\n run.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF)\n shading = OxmlElement(\"w:shd\")\n shading.set(qn(\"w:val\"), \"clear\")\n shading.set(qn(\"w:fill\"), accent)\n cells[i]._tc.get_or_add_tcPr().append(shading)\n for row in rows:\n cells = table.add_row().cells\n for i, value in enumerate(row):\n if i >= n_cols:\n break\n cells[i].text = \"\"\n para = cells[i].paragraphs[0]\n run = para.add_run(_clean(\"\" if value is None else str(value)))\n run.font.size = Pt(font_size_pt)\n if col_widths_cm:\n for row in table.rows:\n for i, width in enumerate(col_widths_cm[:n_cols]):\n row.cells[i].width = Cm(width)\n self.doc.add_paragraph()\n return self._table_no\n\n def header_block_table(self, pairs: list[tuple[str, str]], font_size_pt: float = 9.5) -> None:\n \"\"\"Two label/value pairs per row, like the field sheet headers.\"\"\"\n table = self.doc.add_table(rows=0, cols=4)\n table.style = \"Table Grid\"\n for i in range(0, len(pairs), 2):\n row = table.add_row().cells\n for j, (label, value) in enumerate(pairs[i : i + 2]):\n cell_label = row[j * 2]\n cell_value = row[j * 2 + 1]\n cell_label.text = \"\"\n run = cell_label.paragraphs[0].add_run(_clean(label))\n run.font.bold = True\n run.font.size = Pt(font_size_pt)\n cell_value.text = \"\"\n run_v = cell_value.paragraphs[0].add_run(_clean(str(value)))\n run_v.font.size = Pt(font_size_pt)\n self.doc.add_paragraph()\n\n def signature_block(\n self, name: str, role: str, phone: str = \"\", organisation: str = \"\", email: str = \"\"\n ) -> None:\n self.paragraph(\"REPORT SUBMITTED BY:\", bold=True)\n self.doc.add_paragraph()\n self.doc.add_paragraph()\n self.paragraph(\".\" * 30)\n self.paragraph(name, bold=True)\n p = self.paragraph(role)\n p.runs[0].font.italic = True\n if organisation:\n self.paragraph(organisation)\n if phone:\n self.paragraph(f\"Cell: {phone}\")\n if email:\n self.paragraph(f\"Email: {email}\")\n\n def page_break(self) -> None:\n self.doc.add_paragraph().add_run().add_break(WD_BREAK.PAGE)\n\n # ------------------------------------------------------------------\n # save\n # ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n def save(self, path: str | Path) -> Path:\n path = Path(path)\n path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n core = self.doc.core_properties\n core.title = self.title\n core.author = self.style.organisation or \"Groundwater Toolkit\"\n self._fill_table_of_contents()\n self.doc.save(path)\n _normalise_zip_timestamps(path)\n return path\n\n\ndef _normalise_zip_timestamps(path: Path) -> None:\n \"\"\"Rewrite the .docx zip with fixed timestamps and sorted entries so\n identical content produces an identical file.\"\"\"\n with zipfile.ZipFile(path, \"r\") as zin:\n entries = sorted(zin.namelist())\n contents = {name: zin.read(name) for name in entries}\n with zipfile.ZipFile(path, \"w\", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zout:\n for name in entries:\n info = zipfile.ZipInfo(name, date_time=(2020, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0))\n info.compress_type = zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED\n info.external_attr = 0o600 << 16\n zout.writestr(info, contents[name])\n"}, "groundwater/reporting/geophysical.py": {"t": "text", "d": "\"\"\"Geophysical survey report generator.\n\nFollows the structure of the Rokel example report: table of contents,\nintroduction, background and geology of the project area, field work\n(reconnaissance with geomorphology and hydrogeology, traverse and VES\npoint selection, then survey method and instrument), data analysis\nwith one block per sounding (header and data table, curve and model\nfigure, layer pseudo-section, interpretation paragraph), the ranked\ntable of VES points in order of drilling preference, conclusions and\nrecommendations, and a signature block.\n\nEvery figure and table is numbered by the builder and referenced from\nthe body text; every number in the tables comes from the parsed raw\ndata or the fitted models.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass, field\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom typing import Any\n\nfrom ..config import Config, VESConfig\nfrom ..geo import infer_zone_for_sierra_leone\nfrom ..mapping import (\n apparent_resistivity_pseudosection,\n aquifer_thickness_map,\n bedrock_elevation_map,\n depth_to_bedrock_map,\n geoelectric_section_along_traverse,\n protective_capacity_map,\n suitability_map,\n suitability_map_state,\n traverse_profile,\n)\nfrom ..models import DataFlag, VESSounding\nfrom ..siting import assess_siting, ranking_tie, suitability_map_points\nfrom ..mapping.lithology import region_of\nfrom ..utils import fmt_num, plural, plural_noun, safe_slug, utm_text\nfrom ..ves.classify import classify_curve\nfrom ..ves.interpret import (\n SiteInterpretation,\n drilling_depth_text,\n drilling_preference_table,\n rank_interpretations,\n zone_text,\n)\nfrom ..ves.inversion import InversionResult\nfrom ..ves.plots import plot_model_pseudosection, plot_sounding_curve\nfrom .citations import GLOSSARY, references_for\nfrom .context import context_map_figures\nfrom .docx_utils import ReportBuilder\n\n_DEFAULT_GEOLOGY = (\n \"The project area lies within the crystalline basement terrain of Sierra \"\n \"Leone, where groundwater occurs mainly within the weathered overburden \"\n \"(regolith) and in fractured zones of the underlying bedrock. The \"\n \"weathered zone develops on granites, gneisses and related rocks, and its \"\n \"thickness and degree of fracturing control the groundwater potential. \"\n \"Groundwater quality and quantity can be favourable where the borehole \"\n \"position is properly located through appropriate hydrogeological and \"\n \"geophysical investigations.\"\n)\n\n_FREETOWN_GEOLOGY = (\n \"The project area lies within the Freetown Basic Complex. The Freetown \"\n \"Complex is a layered gabbroic anorthosite intrusion emplaced against \"\n \"gneisses and schists of the Kasila Group, and it forms part of the \"\n \"Peninsula and Banana Islands. It is thought to have been formed by \"\n \"multiple injections of magma that occurred intermittently. Groundwater \"\n \"potential within the Freetown Basic Complex is found within weathered \"\n \"and fractured zones of these igneous (crystalline) rocks. Groundwater \"\n \"quality and quantity can be high if the borehole is properly located \"\n \"through appropriate hydrogeological and geophysical investigations.\"\n)\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass GeophysicalReportInputs:\n \"\"\"Everything the geophysical survey report needs.\"\"\"\n\n soundings: list[VESSounding]\n inversions: list[InversionResult]\n interpretations: list[SiteInterpretation]\n figures_dir: Path\n site_map_path: Path | None = None\n #: A real topographic map, drawn by\n #: :func:`groundwater.mapping.terrain.plot_topographic_map` from an\n #: elevation model the operator supplied. There is no default and none\n #: is generated: the toolkit bundles no elevation data, and a report\n #: that drew contours from nothing would be the worst figure in it.\n topographic_map_path: Path | None = None\n #: What the topographic map was drawn from, for its caption.\n topographic_map_credit: str = \"\"\n #: Ground surface along the traverse, from the levelled soundings.\n ground_profile_path: Path | None = None\n #: The study area at a readable scale, with its locator inset.\n study_area_map_path: Path | None = None\n #: Subsurface maps and sections built from this survey's own soundings,\n #: as ``(path, caption)`` pairs in the order they should appear.\n subsurface_figures: list[tuple[Path, str]] = field(default_factory=list)\n survey_photo_path: Path | None = None\n #: A previous interpretation of the same soundings, keyed by sounding\n #: id - the IPI2Win models transcribed from the original survey report,\n #: say. Each is drawn dashed on its curve figure and tabled beside the\n #: toolkit's model with its reported ERR and the ERR this toolkit gets\n #: for it on the same readings, so a difference is shown, not hidden.\n reference_models: dict | None = None\n reference_label: str = \"IPI2Win model (as reported)\"\n geology_text: str = \"\"\n reconnaissance_date: str = \"\"\n reconnaissance_notes: str = \"\"\n profiling_note: str = \"\"\n geologist_name: str = \"\"\n geologist_role: str = \"Geologist / Field Supervisor\"\n geologist_phone: str = \"\"\n flags: list[DataFlag] = field(default_factory=list)\n include_qa_annex: bool = False\n #: :class:`~groundwater.readiness.Readiness` for this report, from\n #: :func:`groundwater.readiness.assess_readiness`. When it is not\n #: certifiable the cover carries a PROVISIONAL stamp listing why.\n readiness: Any = None\n\n\ndef _geology_for(site, override: str) -> str:\n \"\"\"The geology paragraph, from the map under the site.\n\n With a GPS fix the paragraph names the USGS unit the site sits on and\n the BGS aquifer class, through the same crosswalk the map legend uses,\n so the text and Figures 3 and 4 cannot disagree. Without a fix, the\n district's region decides; the Western Area gets the Freetown Complex\n paragraph because the whole peninsula is the Freetown Complex, not\n because the word \"western\" appears.\n \"\"\"\n if override:\n return override\n district = getattr(site, \"district\", \"\") or \"\"\n latlon = getattr(site, \"latlon\", None)\n if latlon is not None:\n from ..mapping import aquifer_unit_at, geology_unit_at\n from ..mapping.lithology import describe\n\n lat, lon = latlon\n unit = geology_unit_at(lat, lon)\n aquifer = aquifer_unit_at(lat, lon)\n parts = []\n if unit is not None:\n told = describe(unit.glg, district)\n parts.append(\n \"The site lies on the unit the USGS Geologic Map of Africa \"\n f\"maps as {unit.unit} ({unit.glg}). \"\n + (told if told else \"\")\n )\n if aquifer is not None:\n parts.append(\n \"The BGS Africa Groundwater Atlas classes the aquifer here as \"\n f\"{aquifer.unit}\"\n + (f\" ({aquifer.era.lower()})\" if aquifer.era else \"\") + \".\"\n )\n if parts:\n return \" \".join(p.strip() for p in parts) + (\n \" Groundwater potential depends on the thickness of the \"\n \"weathered zone and the degree of fracturing beneath it, which \"\n \"the soundings below resolve.\"\n )\n if region_of(district) == \"Western Area\":\n return _FREETOWN_GEOLOGY\n return _DEFAULT_GEOLOGY\n\n\ndef build_geophysical_report(\n inputs: GeophysicalReportInputs,\n out_path: str | Path,\n config: Config | None = None,\n) -> Path:\n \"\"\"Write the geophysical survey report to ``out_path`` (.docx).\"\"\"\n config = config or Config()\n soundings = inputs.soundings\n if not soundings:\n raise ValueError(\"At least one sounding is required\")\n site = soundings[0].site\n community = site.community or \"the project area\"\n district = site.district or \"\"\n client = site.client or \"the client\"\n\n rb = ReportBuilder(config.style, title=f\"Geophysical Survey Report - {community}\")\n\n # One ranking for the whole document, assigned before anything reads it:\n # the executive summary, the preference table, the suitability section\n # and the recommendations all name the same preferred point because they\n # all read `rank`, and rank is the confidence-weighted suitability.\n rank_interpretations(inputs.interpretations, config=config.ves)\n\n # ---- cover -------------------------------------------------------------\n rb.cover(\n title_lines=[\"GEOPHYSICAL SURVEY REPORT\"],\n subtitle_lines=[\n \"Groundwater Investigation for Borehole Siting\",\n f\"at {community}\" + (f\", {district} District\"\n if district and \"western\" not in district.lower()\n else f\", {district}\" if district else \"\"),\n ],\n details=[\n (\"Client\", client),\n (\"Project\", site.project or \"Geophysical Survey\"),\n (\"Survey date\", soundings[0].site.date or \"\"),\n (\"Prepared by\", inputs.geologist_name or config.style.organisation or \"\"),\n ],\n )\n rb.provisional_stamp(inputs.readiness)\n\n # ---- table of contents ---------------------------------------------------\n rb.table_of_contents()\n\n # ---- executive summary ---------------------------------------------------\n exec_paras, exec_key = _executive_summary(soundings, inputs.interpretations,\n community, district)\n rb.executive_summary(exec_paras, exec_key)\n\n # ---- 1 introduction --------------------------------------------------------\n rb.heading(\"1. Introduction\", 1)\n rb.paragraph(\n \"Geological and hydrogeological/geophysical investigations are \"\n f\"prerequisites for borehole drilling. {client} requested a \"\n \"geophysical investigation to site the borehole position at \"\n f\"{community}\" + (f\" in {district}\" if district else \"\") + \". \"\n \"The study assessed the possibility of accessing groundwater in the \"\n \"project area, and the details of the investigations are documented \"\n \"in this report.\",\n align=\"justify\",\n )\n\n # ---- 2 background / geology ---------------------------------------------\n rb.heading(\"2. Background and Geology of the Project Area\", 1)\n rb.paragraph(_geology_for(site, inputs.geology_text), align=\"justify\")\n # the soundings go on the study area map, so a reader can see the survey\n # laid out in the area rather than having to hold two figures together;\n # the recommended one gets the one marker on a siting map that has to\n # be unmistakable, and the site star is not drawn on top of whichever\n # sounding happened to be first on the sheet\n preferred = _preferred(inputs.interpretations)\n survey_overlay = [\n {\"lat\": s.site.latlon[0], \"lon\": s.site.latlon[1],\n \"label\": s.sounding_id,\n \"kind\": (\"recommended point\" if s.sounding_id == preferred.sounding_id\n else \"VES point\")}\n for s in soundings if s.site.latlon is not None\n ]\n context_maps = context_map_figures(site, inputs.figures_dir, config.style,\n points=survey_overlay, mark_site=False)\n if context_maps:\n if \"study_area\" in context_maps:\n caption = (\n f\"Study area at {community}, with the survey points and its \"\n \"location in Sierra Leone inset. The star is the recommended \"\n f\"drilling point, {preferred.sounding_id}.\"\n )\n spread = _survey_spread_km(soundings)\n if spread > 5.0:\n caption += (\n f\" The survey points are up to {spread:.1f} km apart, which \"\n \"is unusually far for one site; the positions should be \"\n \"checked against the field notes.\"\n )\n caption += \" Boundaries from geoBoundaries (CC BY 4.0).\"\n rb.figure(context_maps[\"study_area\"], caption)\n rb.figure(\n context_maps[\"admin\"],\n f\"Location of {community}. Boundaries from geoBoundaries \"\n \"(CC BY 4.0).\",\n )\n rb.figure(\n context_maps[\"hydrogeology\"],\n \"Aquifer type and productivity around the site, from the BGS \"\n \"Africa Groundwater Atlas country map (CC BY-SA 4.0).\",\n )\n rb.figure(\n context_maps[\"geology\"],\n \"Geological setting around the site, from the USGS Geologic \"\n \"Map of Africa (1:5,000,000). The Geology of Sierra Leone map \"\n \"(Ministry of Water Resources/SALWACO, 2017) gives the \"\n \"detailed local formations.\",\n )\n\n # ---- 3 field work -----------------------------------------------------------\n rb.heading(\"3. Field Work\", 1)\n rb.heading(\"3.1 Reconnaissance Survey\", 2)\n # What this section says has to be evidenced by the inputs. It used to\n # assert a reconnaissance dated the survey day, a geomorphological\n # survey of slopes and streams, and a formation assessment, for every\n # survey, whatever the sheets held: a client read a day of field work\n # nobody had recorded. A recorded date or notes are printed; without\n # them the section says so.\n if inputs.reconnaissance_date or inputs.reconnaissance_notes:\n rb.paragraph(\n \"The reconnaissance survey selected the points for the \"\n \"geophysical survey\"\n + (f\" and was conducted on {inputs.reconnaissance_date}\"\n if inputs.reconnaissance_date else \"\")\n + \".\",\n align=\"justify\",\n )\n if inputs.reconnaissance_notes:\n rb.paragraph(\"Field observations\", bold=True)\n rb.paragraph(inputs.reconnaissance_notes, align=\"justify\")\n else:\n rb.paragraph(\n \"No reconnaissance record (date or field observations) was \"\n \"supplied with the sounding data, so none is reported here. The \"\n \"sounding points were taken as recorded on the field sheets\"\n + (f\", dated {site.date}\" if site.date else \"\") + \".\",\n align=\"justify\",\n )\n rb.paragraph(\n \"The weathered zone over the bedrock and the fractured rock beneath \"\n \"it are the groundwater prospects in this ground, and the soundings \"\n \"below are interpreted for both.\",\n align=\"justify\",\n )\n if inputs.site_map_path and Path(inputs.site_map_path).exists():\n # Captioned for what it is. This said \"Topographic map of the project\n # area\" over whatever figure a caller passed, and what callers pass is\n # a survey point location map: no elevation, no contour, no relief.\n # A reader looking for the valley on a topographic map and finding a\n # scatter of pegs has been told something untrue about the evidence.\n # A real topographic map needs an elevation model, which this toolkit\n # does not carry; groundwater.mapping.terrain draws one from a model\n # the operator supplies, and inputs.topographic_map_path is where it\n # goes when there is one.\n rb.figure(inputs.site_map_path,\n f\"Survey point location map of the project area at {community}.\")\n if inputs.topographic_map_path and Path(inputs.topographic_map_path).exists():\n rb.figure(\n inputs.topographic_map_path,\n f\"Topographic map of the project area at {community}. \"\n f\"{inputs.topographic_map_credit}\".strip(),\n )\n else:\n # silent before: a report with no topographic map said nothing\n # about why, and a reader took the survey point map for one\n rb.paragraph(\n \"No elevation model was supplied with this survey, so no \"\n \"topographic map is drawn: the toolkit bundles none and invents \"\n \"none. The elevations the crew recorded at the soundings are \"\n \"the ground levels this report has.\",\n align=\"justify\",\n )\n profile_path = inputs.ground_profile_path\n if not (profile_path and Path(profile_path).exists()):\n profile_path = _ground_profile_figure(inputs, community)\n if profile_path is not None:\n rb.figure(\n profile_path,\n \"Ground surface along the survey traverse, from the elevation \"\n \"recorded at each sounding.\",\n )\n\n rb.paragraph(\"Sounding positions\", bold=True)\n placed = [s for s in soundings if s.site.easting is not None and s.site.northing is not None]\n rb.paragraph(\n f\"{plural(len(placed), 'sounding')} of {len(soundings)} \"\n + (\"carry\" if len(placed) != 1 else \"carries\")\n + \" a recorded GPS position, plotted on the survey point map. \"\n + (inputs.profiling_note if inputs.profiling_note else\n \"How the points were chosen on the ground is not recorded on the \"\n \"field sheets; where a traverse or profiling was run, its notes \"\n \"belong in the reconnaissance record above.\"),\n align=\"justify\",\n )\n\n rb.heading(\"3.2 Geophysical Survey\", 2)\n instrument = soundings[0].instrument or \"Syscal Junior\"\n rb.paragraph(\n \"The geophysical survey consisted of electrical resistivity \"\n \"measurements, specifically vertical electrical sounding (VES) \"\n f\"using the {instrument} instrument.\",\n align=\"justify\",\n )\n if inputs.survey_photo_path and Path(inputs.survey_photo_path).exists():\n rb.figure(\n inputs.survey_photo_path,\n f\"Geophysical survey using the {instrument} equipment.\",\n )\n\n rb.heading(\"3.2.1 Vertical Electrical Sounding (VES)\", 3)\n labels = \", \".join(s.sounding_id for s in soundings)\n arrays = sorted({(s.array_type or \"schlumberger\").capitalize() for s in soundings})\n rb.paragraph(\n f\"{plural(len(soundings), 'vertical electrical sounding')} \"\n f\"({labels}) {'was' if len(soundings) == 1 else 'were'} recorded with \"\n f\"the {' and '.join(arrays)} electrode configuration, to determine the \"\n \"formation resistivities and the depth to bedrock, and whether water \"\n \"bearing fractures or a saturated weathered zone are present at depth \"\n \"and how thick they are. No resistivity profiling record was supplied\"\n + (\".\" if not inputs.profiling_note else\n \"; the profiling note above describes what was run.\"),\n align=\"justify\",\n )\n\n # ---- 4 data analysis ------------------------------------------------------\n rb.heading(\"4.
