Data Analysis and Interpretation\", 1)\n # one inversion and one interpretation per sounding, built in lockstep by\n # every caller: a short list silently drops a point's whole analysis block\n # while the preference table below still ranks it\n references = inputs.reference_models or {}\n for sounding, inversion, interp in zip(\n soundings, inputs.inversions, inputs.interpretations, strict=True\n ):\n _sounding_block(rb, sounding, inversion, interp, inputs.figures_dir,\n config=config.ves,\n reference_model=references.get(sounding.sounding_id),\n reference_label=inputs.reference_label)\n\n # ---- preference table -----------------------------------------------------\n rows = drilling_preference_table(inputs.interpretations, config=config.ves)\n header = list(rows[0].keys()) if rows else []\n open_ended = any(i.basement_not_resolved for i in inputs.interpretations)\n rb.table(\n [[row[h] for h in header] for row in rows],\n header=header,\n caption=(\n \"List of VES points in order of preference for drilling. The \"\n \"resistivities are those of the fitted layers, not the apparent \"\n \"resistivities read in the field.\"\n + (\" A water zone marked + continues below the depth the \"\n \"sounding resolves, so its base and the drilling depth are \"\n \"minima.\" if open_ended else \"\")\n ),\n font_size_pt=8.5,\n )\n\n # ---- drill-target suitability --------------------------------------------\n _suitability_block(rb, inputs, site, config.ves)\n\n # ---- 5 conclusions and recommendations -------------------------------------\n rb.heading(\"5. Conclusions and Recommendations\", 1)\n rb.paragraph(\"Conclusions:\", bold=True)\n conclusions = _conclusions(inputs.interpretations, district, community)\n rb.bullets(conclusions)\n rb.paragraph(\"Recommendations:\", bold=True)\n rb.bullets(_recommendations(inputs.interpretations))\n\n # ---- 6 limitations and uncertainty -----------------------------------------\n rb.heading(\"6. Limitations and Uncertainty\", 1)\n rb.bullets(_limitations(inputs.inversions, inputs.interpretations, config.ves))\n\n # ---- QA annex (optional) -----------------------------------------------------\n if inputs.include_qa_annex and inputs.flags:\n rb.heading(\"Annex A. Data Verification Notes\", 1)\n rb.paragraph(\n \"The following checks were raised automatically during data \"\n \"processing and should be verified against the field notes.\"\n )\n rb.bullets([str(f) for f in inputs.flags])\n\n # ---- references and glossary -----------------------------------------------\n rb.references(references_for(\"geophysical\"))\n rb.glossary(GLOSSARY)\n\n # ---- signature ------------------------------------------------------------\n rb.signature_block(\n name=inputs.geologist_name or soundings[0].site.supervisor or \"\",\n role=inputs.geologist_role,\n phone=inputs.geologist_phone,\n organisation=config.style.organisation,\n )\n\n return rb.save(out_path)\n\n\ndef _limitations(\n inversions: list[InversionResult],\n interpretations: list[SiteInterpretation] | None = None,\n config: VESConfig | None = None,\n) -> list[str]:\n \"\"\"Honest, calibrated limitations for the VES interpretation.\"\"\"\n config = config or VESConfig()\n interpretations = interpretations or []\n spacings = [i.max_spacing_m for i in interpretations if i.max_spacing_m]\n dois = [i.investigation_depth_m for i in interpretations if i.investigation_depth_m]\n if spacings and dois:\n fraction = config.depth_of_investigation_factor\n fraction_text = \"half\" if abs(fraction - 0.5) < 1e-9 else f\"{fraction:g} times\"\n depth_item = (\n \"A Schlumberger sounding resolves the ground to roughly \"\n f\"{fraction_text} its largest AB/2, not to the spacing itself: with \"\n f\"AB/2 expanded to {fmt_num(max(spacings))} m the depth of \"\n f\"investigation here is about {fmt_num(max(dois))} m, and any \"\n \"structure below it is not resolved. A layer that continues to that \"\n \"depth has no base in these data.\"\n )\n else:\n depth_item = (\n \"The depth of investigation is a fraction of the largest electrode \"\n \"spacing (roughly half of AB/2 for a Schlumberger sounding), so any \"\n \"structure below it is not resolved.\"\n )\n items = [\n (\"Resistivity models are not unique: different layered models can fit \"\n \"the same sounding curve almost equally well (the equivalence and \"\n \"suppression problem), so the interpreted layer depths and \"\n \"thicknesses carry an uncertainty of the order of plus or minus 20 \"\n \"percent.\"),\n (\"A low resistivity layer can represent either a saturated, water \"\n \"bearing zone or a conductive clay; the interpretation is made from \"\n \"the geological context and must be confirmed by drilling.\"),\n depth_item,\n (\"The survey indicates groundwater potential only. The actual yield and \"\n \"water quality can be confirmed only by test drilling, test pumping \"\n \"and laboratory analysis.\"),\n ]\n errs = [inv.fit_error_percent for inv in inversions if inv.fit_error_percent is not None]\n if errs:\n worst = max(errs)\n sentence = (\n \"The fitted models reproduce the measured apparent resistivities \"\n f\"to within {worst:.1f} percent (ERR); a larger misfit means a \"\n \"less certain model.\"\n )\n if worst > config.target_fit_percent:\n over = [\n inv.model.sounding_id or f\"sounding {k + 1}\"\n for k, inv in enumerate(inversions)\n if inv.fit_error_percent is not None\n and inv.fit_error_percent > config.target_fit_percent\n ]\n sentence += (\n f\" The target is {config.target_fit_percent:g} percent, and \"\n + \", \".join(over)\n + (\" does\" if len(over) == 1 else \" do\")\n + \" not reach it: the layer depths there are indicative, and \"\n \"the ranking discounts them for it.\"\n )\n items.insert(0, sentence)\n return items\n\n\n\ndef _site_slug(site) -> str:\n \"\"\"Filename fragment identifying the survey site.\"\"\"\n return safe_slug(getattr(site, \"community\", \"\") or \"site\", \"site\")\n\n\ndef _survey_spread_km(soundings: list[VESSounding]) -> float:\n \"\"\"The largest distance between any two positioned soundings, in km.\"\"\"\n from ..geo import geodesic_distance_m\n\n placed = [s.site.latlon for s in soundings if s.site.latlon is not None]\n widest = 0.0\n for a in range(len(placed)):\n for b in range(a + 1, len(placed)):\n widest = max(widest, geodesic_distance_m(placed[a][0], placed[a][1],\n placed[b][0], placed[b][1]))\n return widest / 1000.0\n\n\ndef _sounding_block(\n rb: ReportBuilder,\n sounding: VESSounding,\n inversion: InversionResult,\n interp: SiteInterpretation,\n figures_dir: Path,\n config: VESConfig | None = None,\n reference_model=None,\n reference_label: str = \"reference model\",\n) -> None:\n \"\"\"One data analysis block per sounding: tables, figures, narrative.\"\"\"\n config = config or VESConfig()\n site = sounding.site\n sid = sounding.sounding_id\n # site as well as sounding id: two surveys both with a sounding \"A\"\n # share one figures directory in an app session, and generation is\n # guarded by an existence check, so the second reused the first's curve.\n safe_id = f\"{_site_slug(site)}_{safe_slug(sid, 'ves')}\"\n\n # data table with the field sheet header block\n table_no = rb.next_table_number\n # A Wenner sounding reaches this table now that the reader can take one,\n # and the table was hard-coded Schlumberger: the spacing column was\n # headed AB/2 although it held a, and the MN column printed \"n/a\" on\n # every row of a sounding that has no MN by construction.\n is_wenner = sounding.array_type.startswith(\"wenner\")\n array_name = \"Wenner\" if is_wenner else \"Schlumberger\"\n spacing_text = (\n \"the electrode spacing a\"\n if is_wenner\n else \"half the current electrode spacing (AB/2)\"\n )\n rb.paragraph(\n f\"Table {table_no} presents the {array_name} array VES data recorded \"\n f\"at point {sid}, from which the sounding curve of apparent \"\n f\"resistivity against {spacing_text} in \"\n f\"Figure {rb.next_figure_number} is plotted.\",\n align=\"justify\",\n )\n rb.header_block_table(\n [\n (\"Client\", site.client), (\"Community\", site.community),\n (\"Project\", site.project or \"Geophysical Survey\"), (\"Sounding Number\", sid),\n (\"District\", site.district), (\"GPS Coordinate East\", utm_text(site, \"easting\")),\n (\"Date\", site.date), (\"GPS Coordinate North\", utm_text(site, \"northing\")),\n (\"Field Supervisor\", site.supervisor),\n (\"Elevation\", fmt_num(site.elevation_m) + \" m\" if site.elevation_m else \"\"),\n ]\n )\n # the parser appends AB/2, MN and rho per row (blank MN becomes NaN),\n # so a length mismatch means a hand-built sounding, not a short sheet\n triples = list(zip(sounding.ab2, sounding.mn, sounding.rho_app, strict=True))\n if is_wenner:\n rows = [[i + 1, fmt_num(a), fmt_num(r, 4)] for i, (a, _m, r) in enumerate(triples)]\n header = [\"No.\", \"a (m)\", \"Apparent Resistivity (ohm-m)\"]\n widths = [1.5, 3.0, 7.0]\n else:\n rows = [[i + 1, fmt_num(a), fmt_num(m), fmt_num(r, 4)]\n for i, (a, m, r) in enumerate(triples)]\n header = [\"No.\", \"AB/2 (m)\", \"MN (m)\", \"Apparent Resistivity (ohm-m)\"]\n widths = [1.5, 3.0, 3.0, 7.0]\n rb.table(\n rows,\n header=header,\n caption=f\"{array_name} array VES data at point {sid}.\",\n col_widths_cm=widths,\n )\n\n # curve + model figure, drawn to the depth of investigation, with the\n # reference interpretation dashed beside the toolkit's where one exists\n curve_path = figures_dir / f\"ves_curve_{safe_id}.png\"\n plot_sounding_curve(\n sounding, inversion.model, inversion.rho_calc, inversion.ab2, path=curve_path,\n depth_max=interp.investigation_depth_m or None,\n reference_model=reference_model, reference_label=reference_label,\n )\n rb.figure(\n curve_path,\n f\"Schlumberger array VES curve and model at point {sid}.\"\n + (f\" The dashed line is the {reference_label}.\" if reference_model is not None else \"\")\n + \" The model panel is drawn to the depth of investigation \"\n f\"({fmt_num(interp.investigation_depth_m)} m).\",\n )\n\n # model table (IPI2Win layout) with linearised uncertainty factors\n rho_fac = inversion.rho_uncertainty_factor\n h_fac = inversion.h_uncertainty_factor\n model_rows = []\n for i, row in enumerate(inversion.model.as_table()):\n rho_cell = fmt_num(row[\"rho_ohm_m\"], 4)\n if rho_fac is not None and i < len(rho_fac):\n rho_cell += f\" (x/ {rho_fac[i]:.1f})\"\n if row[\"h_m\"] is not None:\n h_cell = fmt_num(row[\"h_m\"])\n if h_fac is not None and i < len(h_fac):\n h_cell += f\" (x/ {h_fac[i]:.1f})\"\n else:\n h_cell = \"\"\n model_rows.append(\n [\n row[\"N\"],\n rho_cell,\n h_cell,\n \"half-space\" if row[\"z_m\"] == \"0/0\" else fmt_num(row[\"z_m\"]),\n ]\n )\n err = inversion.fit_error_percent\n rb.table(\n model_rows,\n header=[\"N\", \"rho (ohm-m)\", \"h (m)\", \"z (m)\"],\n caption=(\n f\"Layered earth model at point {sid} \"\n f\"(curve type {classify_curve(inversion.model)}, ERR = {err:.1f}%). \"\n \"The (x/ factor) is the linearised 1-sigma uncertainty; a factor \"\n \"near 1 is well resolved and a large factor marks equivalence.\"\n ),\n col_widths_cm=[1.2, 4.6, 3.4, 2.8],\n )\n # what else was tried, so the model in the table is seen as one choice\n # among the candidates rather than the only reading of the curve\n trials = [(n, e) for n, e in inversion.trials if e is not None]\n if len(trials) > 1:\n tried = \"; \".join(f\"{n} layers, {e:.1f}%\" for n, e in trials)\n chosen = inversion.model.n_layers\n if err <= config.target_fit_percent:\n why = (\n f\"the {chosen}-layer model is the simplest that reaches the \"\n f\"{config.target_fit_percent:g} percent target\"\n )\n else:\n why = (\n f\"none reaches the {config.target_fit_percent:g} percent target, \"\n f\"and the {chosen}-layer model is kept as the simplest within \"\n f\"{(config.parsimony_fallback_ratio - 1) * 100:.0f} percent of \"\n \"the best fit; the alternatives are equally admissible readings \"\n \"of the same curve\"\n )\n rb.paragraph(f\"Models tried: {tried}. Of these {why}.\", align=\"justify\")\n # a poorly resolved boundary is said to be one, in the sentence that\n # the table caption's factor already implies\n if h_fac is not None and len(h_fac):\n weak = [\n (inversion.model.depths_bottom[i], float(f))\n for i, f in enumerate(h_fac) if f >= 2.0\n ]\n if weak:\n rb.paragraph(\n \"The boundary at \"\n + \", \".join(f\"{fmt_num(z)} m (x/ {f:.1f})\" for z, f in weak)\n + \" is poorly resolved: within its uncertainty the model \"\n \"collapses to one with a layer fewer, so the layer count \"\n \"above is a reading of the curve rather than a property of it.\",\n align=\"justify\",\n )\n if reference_model is not None:\n _reference_model_block(rb, sid, inversion, reference_model, reference_label,\n sounding.array_type)\n\n # the interpreted layer column, drawn to the depth of investigation\n layer_path = figures_dir / f\"ves_layer_section_{safe_id}.png\"\n plot_model_pseudosection(\n inversion.model,\n path=layer_path,\n depth_max=interp.investigation_depth_m or None,\n title=f\"Layer section at {sid}\",\n )\n rb.figure(\n layer_path,\n f\"Interpreted one-dimensional layer section at point {sid}: the \"\n \"resistivity and thickness of each fitted layer, drawn to the depth \"\n f\"of investigation ({fmt_num(interp.investigation_depth_m)} m).\",\n )\n\n # interpretation paragraph\n rb.paragraph(interp.narrative, align=\"justify\")\n rb.page_break()\n\n\ndef _reference_model_block(rb, sid, inversion, reference_model, label,\n array_type: str = \"schlumberger\") -> None:\n \"\"\"The previous interpretation of the same curve, beside the toolkit's.\n\n The comparison the reader will make anyway is made for them: the\n reference model's layers, the ERR it reported, and the ERR this\n toolkit computes for that model on the same readings. Where the two\n ERRs disagree, the reader is told rather than left to find it.\n \"\"\"\n from ..ves.forward import forward_schlumberger, forward_wenner\n from ..ves.inversion import fit_error_percent\n\n forward = forward_wenner if str(array_type).startswith(\"wenner\") else forward_schlumberger\n recomputed = fit_error_percent(inversion.rho_obs, forward(reference_model, inversion.ab2))\n reported = reference_model.fit_error_percent\n rows = [\n [row[\"N\"], fmt_num(row[\"rho_ohm_m\"], 4),\n \"\" if row[\"h_m\"] is None else fmt_num(row[\"h_m\"]),\n \"half-space\" if row[\"z_m\"] == \"0/0\" else fmt_num(row[\"z_m\"])]\n for row in reference_model.as_table()\n ]\n caption = f\"{label[0].upper() + label[1:]} at point {sid}\"\n if reported is not None:\n caption += f\", reported ERR = {reported:.1f}%\"\n caption += f\"; on the readings tabled above this toolkit computes ERR = {recomputed:.1f}%.\"\n rb.table(rows, header=[\"N\", \"rho (ohm-m)\", \"h (m)\", \"z (m)\"], caption=caption,\n col_widths_cm=[1.2, 4.6, 3.4, 2.8])\n own = inversion.model\n sentences = []\n if reference_model.n_layers != own.n_layers:\n sentences.append(\n f\"The reference interpretation has {reference_model.n_layers} layers \"\n f\"where this one has {own.n_layers}.\"\n )\n if reported is not None and abs(recomputed - reported) > 5.0:\n sentences.append(\n f\"Its reported misfit ({reported:.1f} percent) is not reproduced on \"\n f\"these readings ({recomputed:.1f} percent): either the readings \"\n \"it was fitted to differ from the transcribed sheet, or the misfit \"\n \"was defined differently. Neither is settled here.\"\n )\n if sentences:\n rb.paragraph(\" \".join(sentences), align=\"justify\")\n\n\ndef _suitability_block(rb: ReportBuilder, inputs, site,\n config: VESConfig | None = None) -> None:\n \"\"\"Ranked drill-target suitability scorecard, map and recommendation.\"\"\"\n config = config or VESConfig()\n suit = assess_siting(inputs.interpretations, config)\n if not suit:\n return\n rb.heading(\"Drill-target suitability\", 2)\n rb.paragraph(\n \"Each surveyed point is given a transparent suitability score from 0 \"\n \"to 100. The score combines the interpreted water-bearing thickness, \"\n \"how well the resistivity of the water zone sits within the productive \"\n \"fractured or weathered window, the overburden profile, and the \"\n \"presence of a fractured zone at the basement contact. The scores \"\n \"rank the points as drilling targets.\",\n align=\"justify\",\n )\n rb.table(\n [[s.rank, s.sounding_id, f\"{s.suitability:.1f}\", f\"{s.confidence:.2f}\",\n f\"{s.weighted:.1f}\", s.grade] for s in suit],\n header=[\"Rank\", \"VES point\", \"Suitability (0 to 100)\", \"Confidence\",\n \"Weighted\", \"Grade\"],\n caption=(\n \"Drill-target suitability of the surveyed points. Suitability is \"\n \"the geological score; confidence discounts it for a model fit \"\n \"above the target and for a water-bearing zone whose base the \"\n \"sounding never reached; the points are ranked on the weighted \"\n \"figure.\"\n ),\n col_widths_cm=[1.4, 3.0, 3.6, 2.4, 2.2, 3.4],\n )\n # the same rank the rest of the document carries: rank_interpretations()\n # ranks on the weighted suitability, so the table above and the preferred\n # point named everywhere else agree by construction\n best = suit[0]\n tie = ranking_tie(suit, within_points=config.ranking_tie_points)\n if tie:\n rb.paragraph(\n f\"{tie} Point {best.sounding_id}: {best.rationale}\",\n align=\"justify\",\n )\n else:\n rb.paragraph(\n f\"Point {best.sounding_id} ranks first (suitability \"\n f\"{best.suitability:.0f} out of 100, {best.grade.lower()}, confidence \"\n f\"{best.confidence:.2f}) and is the recommended drilling target. \"\n f\"{best.rationale}\",\n align=\"justify\",\n )\n map_points = suitability_map_points(suit)\n if map_points:\n zone = site.utm_zone or infer_zone_for_sierra_leone(map_points[0].easting)\n smap = Path(inputs.figures_dir) / f\"suitability_map_{_site_slug(site)}.png\"\n try:\n suitability_map(map_points, zone, path=smap)\n except (ValueError, RuntimeError) as exc:\n rb.paragraph(f\"The drill-target map could not be drawn: {exc}\")\n else:\n state = suitability_map_state(map_points)\n caption = (\n \"Drill-target suitability of the surveyed points, coloured by \"\n \"the confidence-weighted score; greener is more suitable.\"\n )\n if state[\"tie\"]:\n caption += (\n \" The two highest-ranked points cannot be told apart on \"\n \"geophysical grounds, so neither is starred.\"\n )\n elif state[\"recommended\"]:\n caption += (\n f\" The star is the recommended target, {state['recommended']}, \"\n \"with its grid coordinates.\"\n )\n if state[\"surface\"]:\n caption += (\n \" The surface between the points is interpolated and blanked \"\n \"outside the ground they enclose.\"\n )\n elif state[\"n_points\"] >= 3:\n caption += (\n \" The points lie on one line and enclose no area, so no \"\n \"surface is interpolated between them.\"\n )\n rb.figure(smap, caption)\n\n _add_subsurface_figures(rb, inputs.soundings, inputs.interpretations,\n inputs, site)\n\n\ndef _add_subsurface_figures(rb, soundings, interpretations, inputs, site) -> None:\n \"\"\"Maps of the ground under the site, from the soundings themselves.\n\n Everything in this section is this survey's own measurement: the\n regional geology and aquifer maps earlier in the report are national\n datasets read at a point, and at 1:5,000,000 they cannot say what is\n under one village. These can, within the ground the survey covered.\n\n Each figure is attempted and skipped if the data will not support it,\n because the reasons differ per figure and none of them should cost\n the report the others: a survey whose curves never reached basement\n has no depth-to-bedrock map but still has an aquifer thickness map,\n and one that recorded no elevations has both but no bedrock surface.\n \"\"\"\n figures_dir = Path(inputs.figures_dir)\n placed = [i for i in interpretations if i.site_easting is not None\n and i.site_northing is not None]\n if len(placed) < 2 and not inputs.subsurface_figures:\n return\n zone = site.utm_zone or (\n infer_zone_for_sierra_leone(placed[0].site_easting) if placed else 28\n )\n slug = _site_slug(site)\n made: list[tuple[Path, str]] = []\n # what was not drawn, and why: a figure missing without a word reads as\n # \"the survey did not attempt this\", and the reason is usually a GPS\n # position nobody recorded, which a reviewer can ask for\n not_drawn: list[str] = []\n plan = (\n (depth_to_bedrock_map, \"depth_to_bedrock\",\n (\"Depth to bedrock across the surveyed ground, from the layered \"\n \"models. The surface is blanked outside the hull of the soundings.\")),\n (aquifer_thickness_map, \"aquifer_thickness\",\n (\"Interpreted thickness of the weathered and fractured zone - the \"\n \"section a borehole is completed in.\")),\n (bedrock_elevation_map, \"bedrock_elevation\",\n (\"The bedrock surface as a landform, from the ground elevation \"\n \"recorded at each sounding less its depth to basement. A low in \"\n \"this surface is a buried valley, which basement groundwater \"\n \"drains towards.\")),\n (protective_capacity_map, \"protective_capacity\",\n (\"Protective capacity of the cover over the aquifer, from the \"\n \"longitudinal conductance of the overlying layers. It rates how \"\n \"well the ground above the aquifer resists downward contamination; \"\n \"it says nothing about yield.\")),\n )\n names = {\n \"depth_to_bedrock\": \"depth to bedrock map\",\n \"aquifer_thickness\": \"aquifer thickness map\",\n \"bedrock_elevation\": \"bedrock elevation map\",\n \"protective_capacity\": \"protective capacity map\",\n }\n for fn, name, caption in plan:\n try:\n made.append((fn(placed, zone,\n path=figures_dir / f\"{name}_{slug}.png\"), caption))\n except (ValueError, RuntimeError) as exc:\n # the reason is per-figure and the others still stand; a Qhull\n # error on a straight traverse is a RuntimeError, and it used to\n # walk past this line and take the whole report down\n not_drawn.append(f\"{names[name]}: {exc}\")\n try:\n made.append((\n geoelectric_section_along_traverse(\n placed, path=figures_dir / f\"geoelectric_section_{slug}.png\"),\n (\"Interpreted geoelectric section along the traverse, with the \"\n \"soundings at their surveyed spacing rather than evenly spaced \"\n \"and drawn to the depth of investigation. Colour is layer \"\n \"resistivity; the dashed lines correlate boundaries between \"\n \"neighbouring soundings within reach of each other and are an \"\n \"interpretation, not a measured contact.\"),\n ))\n except (ValueError, KeyError, RuntimeError) as exc:\n not_drawn.append(f\"geoelectric section: {exc}\")\n try:\n profile = traverse_profile(placed)\n pseudo = apparent_resistivity_pseudosection(\n soundings, profile, path=figures_dir / f\"pseudosection_{slug}.png\")\n caption = (\n \"Apparent resistivity along the traverse, as measured. Unlike \"\n \"every other section in this report it involves no inversion: \"\n \"each point is a reading at the station and electrode spacing \"\n \"it was taken with. AB/2 is that spacing, not a depth. Colour is \"\n \"interpolated only between stations within reach of each other.\"\n )\n if not profile.is_collinear:\n caption += (\n f\" The soundings sit up to {profile.max_offset_m:.0f} m off \"\n \"the profile line, so this section cuts across the survey \"\n \"rather than along it.\"\n )\n made.append((pseudo, caption))\n except (ValueError, KeyError, RuntimeError) as exc:\n not_drawn.append(f\"apparent-resistivity pseudo-section: {exc}\")\n made.extend(inputs.subsurface_figures)\n if not made and not not_drawn:\n return\n rb.heading(\"Subsurface maps from the survey\", 2)\n if made:\n rb.paragraph(\n \"The maps in this section are drawn from the soundings themselves \"\n \"rather than from a national dataset, so they carry the survey's own \"\n \"resolution. Each interpolated surface is blanked outside the ground \"\n \"the soundings enclose: a contour beyond the last peg is the \"\n \"interpolator continuing a trend, and a borehole gets sited on it.\",\n align=\"justify\",\n )\n for path, caption in made:\n rb.figure(path, caption)\n if not_drawn:\n rb.paragraph(\n (\"Not drawn from this survey, and why:\" if made else\n \"No subsurface map or section could be drawn from this survey:\"),\n bold=True,\n )\n rb.bullets([_sentence(reason) for reason in not_drawn])\n\n\ndef _ground_profile_figure(inputs: GeophysicalReportInputs, community: str):\n \"\"\"The ground profile the recorded levels support, or None.\n\n Two soundings with positions and elevations are a profile; the report\n used to leave it undrawn unless a caller drew it first.\n \"\"\"\n from ..mapping.terrain import plot_ground_profile\n\n levelled = [\n i for i in inputs.interpretations\n if getattr(i, \"site_easting\", None) is not None\n and getattr(i, \"site_northing\", None) is not None\n and getattr(i, \"site_elevation_m\", None) is not None\n ]\n if len(levelled) < 2:\n return None\n try:\n profile = traverse_profile(levelled)\n by_id = {i.sounding_id: i for i in levelled}\n path = Path(inputs.figures_dir) / f\"ground_profile_{safe_slug(community, 'site')}.png\"\n plot_ground_profile(\n profile.chainage_m,\n [by_id[label].site_elevation_m for label in profile.labels],\n labels=list(profile.labels), path=path,\n )\n return path\n except (ValueError, RuntimeError, KeyError):\n return None\n\n\ndef _sentence(text: str) -> str:\n text = text.strip()\n return text[0].upper() + text[1:] + (\"\" if text.endswith(\".\") else \".\")\n\n\ndef _executive_summary(\n soundings: list[VESSounding],\n interpretations: list[SiteInterpretation],\n community: str,\n district: str,\n) -> tuple[list[str], list[str]]:\n \"\"\"Compose the geophysical executive summary from the ranked results.\"\"\"\n # The preferred point is the one ranked first; build_geophysical_report\n # ranks before anything reads it, and the fallback keeps an unranked\n # list deterministic.\n best = _preferred(interpretations)\n n = len(soundings)\n zones = best.water_zones\n if zones:\n zone_txt = \"; \".join(\n zone_text(t, b, open_ended=(best.basement_not_resolved and (t, b) == zones[-1]))\n for t, b in zones\n )\n zone_sentence = (\n \"The most promising water bearing zone at the preferred point \"\n f\"lies from {zone_txt}.\"\n )\n if best.basement_not_resolved:\n zone_sentence += (\n \" Its base is not resolved: the sounding sees to about \"\n f\"{best.investigation_depth_m:.0f} m and the conductive ground \"\n \"continues below that, so the thickness is a minimum.\"\n )\n else:\n zone_txt = \"\"\n zone_sentence = (\n \"No strongly water bearing zone was resolved at the preferred \"\n \"point within the investigated depth, so the result should be \"\n \"confirmed by test drilling.\"\n )\n para = (\n f\"A geophysical siting survey using {n} vertical electrical sounding \"\n f\"{'point' if n == 1 else 'points'} was carried out at {community}\"\n + (f\", {district}\" if district else \"\")\n + f\". Point {best.sounding_id} is recommended as the preferred \"\n f\"drilling location, to a depth of {drilling_depth_text(best)}. \"\n + zone_sentence\n )\n key = [\n f\"Preferred drilling point: {best.sounding_id}.\",\n f\"Recommended drilling depth: {drilling_depth_text(best)}.\",\n ]\n if zone_txt:\n key.append(f\"Target water {plural_noun(len(zones), 'zone')}: {zone_txt}.\")\n if best.fit_error_percent is not None:\n fit = f\"Model fit at the preferred point: ERR {best.fit_error_percent:.1f} percent\"\n if best.fit_quality == \"unreliable\":\n fit += (\" (well above target; the layer depths are indicative only \"\n f\"and the ranking confidence is {best.confidence:.2f})\")\n elif best.fit_quality == \"poor\":\n fit += (\" (above target; the layer depths are approximate and the \"\n f\"ranking confidence is {best.confidence:.2f})\")\n key.append(fit + \".\")\n key.append(\n \"Yield and water quality can only be confirmed by test drilling and \"\n \"test pumping.\"\n )\n return [para], key\n\n\ndef _preferred(interpretations: list[SiteInterpretation]) -> SiteInterpretation:\n \"\"\"The point ranked first, or a deterministic stand-in when unranked.\"\"\"\n return min(interpretations, key=lambda i: (i.rank or 99, -i.score, i.sounding_id))\n\n\ndef _conclusions(\n interpretations: list[SiteInterpretation], district: str, community: str\n) -> list[str]:\n items = []\n if district and region_of(district) == \"Western Area\":\n items.append(\n \"The project area is part of the Freetown Basic Complex \"\n \"lithological formation.\"\n )\n items.append(\n \"Groundwater potential (quality and quantity) could be favourable at \"\n \"depth within weathered zones and fractured bedrock.\"\n )\n for interp in interpretations:\n if interp.water_zones:\n zones = \" and \".join(\n zone_text(t, b, open_ended=(interp.basement_not_resolved\n and (t, b) == interp.water_zones[-1]))\n for t, b in interp.water_zones\n )\n items.append(\n f\"The potential water zones at point {interp.sounding_id} are \"\n f\"found from {zones}.\"\n + (\" The base of the deepest zone lies below the depth the \"\n \"sounding resolves.\" if interp.basement_not_resolved else \"\")\n )\n else:\n items.append(\n f\"No clearly water bearing zone was resolved at point \"\n f\"{interp.sounding_id} within the investigated depth.\"\n )\n best = _preferred(interpretations)\n items.append(\n f\"Point {best.sounding_id} is selected as the preferred point for \"\n \"drilling according to the results and data analysis.\"\n )\n items.append(\n \"It is premature to estimate quantities, which can only be \"\n \"determined during test drilling and test pumping.\"\n )\n items.append(\n \"The borehole locations were selected within both national and \"\n \"international borehole siting guidelines.\"\n )\n return items\n\n\ndef _recommendations(interpretations: list[SiteInterpretation]) -> list[str]:\n best = _preferred(interpretations)\n others = [i for i in interpretations if i is not best]\n items = [\n (f\"Drilling should be carried out at the selected point \"\n f\"{best.sounding_id} to confirm the existence of groundwater.\")\n ]\n if others:\n items.append(\n (\"Point \" if len(others) == 1 else \"Points \")\n + \", \".join(i.sounding_id for i in others)\n + (\" is an optional drilling point.\" if len(others) == 1\n else \" are optional drilling points.\")\n )\n depths = \"; \".join(\n f\"{drilling_depth_text(i)} at point {i.sounding_id}\"\n for i in sorted(interpretations, key=lambda i: (i.rank or 99, i.sounding_id))\n )\n open_ended = any(i.basement_not_resolved for i in interpretations)\n items.append(\n f\"The drilling depth should be {depths}, to cut across the probable \"\n \"water zones.\"\n + (\" Where the depth is a minimum, the water-bearing zone continues \"\n \"below what the survey resolves: drill on while the formation is \"\n \"water bearing, guided by the strikes and the penetration rate, and \"\n \"stop in fresh rock.\"\n if open_ended else \"\")\n )\n items.append(\n \"The borehole must be constructed using correct and standard \"\n \"materials such as standard uPVC screens and plain casings items\n"}, "groundwater/reporting/handover.py": {"t": "text", "d": "\"\"\"Project handover report generator.\n\nThe closing deliverable for the client, NGO or government partner: a\nproject summary, the works completed, the borehole data sheet with all\nkey results, the as-built design drawing, the water quality verdict,\noperation and maintenance guidance, the community/WASH committee\ndetails, recommendations and the handover signature blocks.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom typing import Any\n\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass, field\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom ..config import Config\nfrom ..design.designer import BoreholeDesign\nfrom ..design.drawing import draw_borehole_design\nfrom ..hydraulics.analysis import PumpingTestAnalysis\nfrom ..models import DrillingLog, SiteMetadata\nfrom ..quality.assess import (\n SUITABILITY_PHRASE,\n SUITABILITY_SENTENCE,\n WaterQualityAssessment,\n)\nfrom ..utils import fmt_num, safe_slug\nfrom .citations import GLOSSARY, references_for\nfrom ..quality.standards import PROVISIONAL_NATIONAL_NOTE, provisional_national_parameters\nfrom ..utils import utm_text\nfrom .context import add_area_section\nfrom .docx_utils import ReportBuilder\n\n_OM_GUIDANCE = [\n (\n \"Daily\",\n [\n (\"Keep the apron and surroundings clean; no washing or animal \"\n \"watering on the apron.\"),\n \"Check for leaks, unusual pump noise and discoloured water.\",\n \"Keep the drainage channel and soakaway free flowing.\",\n ],\n ),\n (\n \"Weekly\",\n [\n \"Tighten loose bolts on the pump head and inspect the apron for cracks.\",\n \"Record the approximate hours of use or strokes per day.\",\n ],\n ),\n (\n \"Monthly\",\n [\n \"Measure and record the water level where a dip access exists.\",\n \"Collect the agreed user fees and update the cash book.\",\n (\"Inspect the fence and the sanitary protection zone (no pit \"\n \"latrine, refuse pit or animal pen within 30 m).\"),\n ],\n ),\n (\n \"Yearly\",\n [\n (\"Service the pump according to the manufacturer schedule and \"\n \"replace fast wearing parts.\"),\n \"Repeat the physico-chemical and bacteriological water tests.\",\n \"Review the tariff against the cost of spare parts.\",\n ],\n ),\n]\n\n#: The same care for a submersible or solar pump, which has no pump rods\n#: and no strokes to count. The handpump list used to go out with a\n#: recorded submersible pump.\n_OM_GUIDANCE_MOTORISED = [\n (\n \"Daily\",\n [\n (\"Keep the pump house, apron and surroundings clean; no washing or \"\n \"animal watering at the tap stand.\"),\n (\"Check for leaks, unusual pump or motor noise, discoloured water \"\n \"and a falling flow.\"),\n \"Keep the drainage channel and soakaway free flowing.\",\n ],\n ),\n (\n \"Weekly\",\n [\n \"Record the hours of pumping and the meter reading, if fitted.\",\n (\"Check the control box, cables, starter and (for a solar pump) \"\n \"the array for damage, loose connections and shading.\"),\n ],\n ),\n (\n \"Monthly\",\n [\n \"Measure and record the water level where a dip access exists.\",\n \"Collect the agreed user fees and update the cash book.\",\n (\"Inspect the fence and the sanitary protection zone (no pit \"\n \"latrine, refuse pit or animal pen within 30 m).\"),\n \"Check the running current against the commissioning value.\",\n ],\n ),\n (\n \"Yearly\",\n [\n (\"Service the pump and motor according to the manufacturer \"\n \"schedule; check the rising main and cable for corrosion and wear.\"),\n \"Repeat the physico-chemical and bacteriological water tests.\",\n \"Review the tariff against the cost of spare parts and power.\",\n ],\n ),\n]\n\n\ndef om_guidance(pump_type: str) -> list:\n \"\"\"The care list for the pump that was actually installed.\"\"\"\n kind = (pump_type or \"\").lower()\n if any(word in kind for word in (\"submersible\", \"solar\", \"motor\", \"electric\")):\n return _OM_GUIDANCE_MOTORISED\n return _OM_GUIDANCE\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass CommitteeMember:\n role: str\n name: str\n phone: str = \"\"\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass HandoverReportInputs:\n site: SiteMetadata\n log: DrillingLog | None = None\n design: BoreholeDesign | None = None\n pumping: PumpingTestAnalysis | None = None\n quality: WaterQualityAssessment | None = None\n figures_dir: Path = Path(\".\")\n works_completed: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)\n # True when a geophysical survey sited the borehole; the default works\n # list only claims the siting survey when the caller says it happened\n sited: bool = False\n committee: list[CommitteeMember] = field(default_factory=list)\n committee_notes: str = \"\"\n tariff_note: str = \"\"\n pump_type: str = \"\"\n extra_recommendations: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)\n contractor_rep: str = \"\"\n client_rep: str = \"\"\n community_rep: str = \"\"\n #: The certification gate for this report, from\n #: :func:`groundwater.readiness.assess_readiness`. When it is not\n #: certifiable the cover says so; when it is absent nothing is\n #: stamped, so an existing caller is unaffected.\n readiness: Any = None\n\n\ndef build_handover_report(\n inputs: HandoverReportInputs,\n out_path: str | Path,\n config: Config | None = None,\n) -> Path:\n config = config or Config()\n site = inputs.site\n figures = Path(inputs.figures_dir)\n figures.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n # Qualify figure filenames with the site: several reports share one\n # figures directory in an app session and generation is guarded by an\n # existence check, so fixed names made the second report silently reuse\n # the first site's figures.\n slug = safe_slug(site.community, \"site\")\n\n rb = ReportBuilder(config.style, title=f\"Handover Report - {site.community}\")\n rb.cover(\n title_lines=[\"PROJECT HANDOVER REPORT\"],\n subtitle_lines=[\n \"Borehole Water Supply\",\n f\"at {site.community}\" + (f\", {site.district} District\" if site.district else \"\"),\n ],\n details=[\n (\"Client\", site.client),\n (\"Project\", site.project),\n (\"Contractor\", site.contractor),\n (\"Date\", site.date),\n ],\n )\n rb.provisional_stamp(inputs.readiness)\n rb.table_of_contents()\n\n # ---- executive summary ----------------------------------------------------\n exec_paras, exec_key = _executive_summary(inputs)\n rb.executive_summary(exec_paras, exec_key)\n\n # ---- 1 project summary ----------------------------------------------------\n rb.heading(\"1. Project Summary\", 1)\n lat_lon = site.latlon\n rb.header_block_table(\n [\n (\"Community\", site.community), (\"Chiefdom\", site.chiefdom),\n (\"District\", site.district), (\"Client\", site.client),\n (\"Contractor\", site.contractor), (\"Project reference\", site.project_ref),\n (\"GPS East\", utm_text(site, \"easting\")),\n (\"GPS North\", utm_text(site, \"northing\")),\n (\"Latitude / Longitude\",\n f\"{lat_lon[0]:.5f} N, {abs(lat_lon[1]):.5f} W\" if lat_lon else \"\"),\n (\"Elevation\",\n fmt_num(site.elevation_m) + \" m\" if site.elevation_m is not None else \"\"),\n ]\n )\n # the same maps and the same note as every other report: a site\n # without a GPS fix gets the area map and the sentence saying the\n # position is not recorded, not a marker-less map captioned as the\n # water point's location\n add_area_section(rb, site, figures, config.style, heading=None)\n\n # ---- 2 works completed ---------------------------------------------------------\n rb.heading(\"2. Works Completed\", 1)\n works = inputs.works_completed or default_works(inputs)\n rb.bullets(works)\n\n # ---- 3 borehole data sheet ---------------------------------------------------\n rb.heading(\"3. Borehole Data Sheet\", 1)\n rows: list[list[str]] = []\n log = inputs.log\n if log is not None:\n rows += [\n [\"Borehole reference\", log.borehole_ref],\n [\"Total depth\", fmt_num(log.total_depth_m) + \" m\"],\n [\"Drilling method\", log.drilling_method],\n [\"Water strikes\", \", \".join(f\"{w:g} m\" for w in log.water_strikes_m) or \"n/a\"],\n [\"Completion date\", log.completion_date],\n [\"Status\", log.status],\n ]\n if inputs.design is not None:\n rows += [[k, v] for k, v in inputs.design.summary_rows()]\n analysis = inputs.pumping\n if analysis is not None:\n if analysis.transmissivity_m2_per_day:\n rows.append([\"Transmissivity\", fmt_num(analysis.transmissivity_m2_per_day) + \" m2/day\"])\n yr = analysis.yield_recommendation\n if yr is not None:\n if yr.safe_yield_m3_per_h:\n rows.append([\n f\"Safe yield (safety factor {yr.safety_factor:g})\",\n yr.yield_range_text\n + (\" (indicative)\" if yr.is_indicative else \"\"),\n ])\n rows.append([\n \"Yield confidence\",\n (\"indicative: \" + \"; \".join(yr.confidence_reasons))\n if yr.is_indicative else \"established\",\n ])\n # the design's intake where there is one: it may have moved the\n # yield's depth out of a screen into plain casing\n intake = (inputs.design.pump_intake_m\n if inputs.design is not None and inputs.design.pump_intake_m\n else yr.pump_installation_depth_m)\n if intake:\n rows.append([\"Pump intake depth\",\n fmt_num(intake) + \" m below the top of the casing\"])\n if inputs.pump_type:\n rows.append([\"Pump type\", inputs.pump_type])\n # one row per item: the log and the design both carry a total depth\n # and a static level, and the sheet printed each twice\n seen: set[str] = set()\n rows = [row for row in rows if not (row[0] in seen or seen.add(row[0]))]\n rb.table(rows, header=[\"Item\", \"Value\"], caption=\"Key borehole data.\")\n\n if inputs.design is not None:\n design_fig = figures / f\"borehole_design_{slug}.png\"\n draw_borehole_design(\n inputs.design, log, path=design_fig, style=config.style,\n title=(f\"As-built borehole record - {site.community}\" if inputs.design.as_built\n else f\"Borehole design - {site.community}\"),\n )\n rb.figure(\n design_fig,\n (\"As-built borehole diagram.\" if inputs.design.as_built\n else \"Borehole construction design generated from the drilling log; \"\n \"the log records no casing string, so this is not an as-built record.\"),\n width_cm=13.0,\n )\n notes = [str(f) for f in inputs.design.flags if f.level in (\"warning\", \"error\")]\n if notes:\n rb.paragraph(\"Design notes:\", bold=True)\n rb.bullets(notes)\n\n # ---- 4 water quality ------------------------------------------------------------\n rb.heading(\"4. Water Quality\", 1)\n if inputs.quality is not None:\n rb.paragraph(inputs.quality.verdict, align=\"justify\")\n # every exceedance, national ones included: a national breach is a\n # compliance failure and must appear in the table, not be dropped\n exceed = inputs.quality.all_exceedances\n if exceed:\n rb.table(\n [[r.parameter, fmt_num(r.value), r.unit, r.remark] for r in exceed],\n header=[\"Parameter\", \"Value\", \"Unit\", \"Remark\"],\n caption=\"Parameters above guideline or standard limits.\",\n )\n # a national limit the quality report calls provisional is\n # provisional here too\n if provisional_national_parameters():\n rb.paragraph(PROVISIONAL_NATIONAL_NOTE, align=\"justify\", italic=True)\n else:\n rb.paragraph(\"Water quality results are reported separately.\")\n\n # ---- 5 O&M -------------------------------------------------------------------------\n rb.heading(\"5. Operation and Maintenance Guidance\", 1)\n rb.paragraph(\n \"The lifetime of the borehole depends on routine care. The tasks \"\n \"below follow standard rural water supply practice; the community \"\n \"should keep a logbook of all maintenance, breakdowns and payments.\",\n align=\"justify\",\n )\n for period, tasks in om_guidance(inputs.pump_type):\n rb.paragraph(period, bold=True)\n rb.bullets(tasks)\n yr = analysis.yield_recommendation if analysis else None\n if yr is not None and yr.safe_yield_m3_per_h:\n rb.paragraph(\n f\"Operate the pump at no more than {fmt_num(yr.safe_yield_m3_per_h)} \"\n \"m3/h and allow the recommended rest periods. If the water level \"\n \"reaches the pump intake, stop pumping and let the borehole recover.\",\n bold=True,\n )\n if inputs.tariff_note:\n rb.paragraph(f\"Tariff arrangement: {inputs.tariff_note}\")\n\n # ---- 6 committee -----------------------------------------------------------------\n rb.heading(\"6. Community / WASH Committee\", 1)\n if inputs.committee:\n rb.table(\n [[m.role, m.name, m.phone] for m in inputs.committee],\n header=[\"Role\", \"Name\", \"Phone\"],\n caption=\"WASH committee members responsible for the water point.\",\n )\n else:\n rb.paragraph(\n \"The WASH committee membership should be recorded here (chair, \"\n \"secretary, treasurer, caretakers) with contact numbers.\"\n )\n if inputs.committee_notes:\n rb.paragraph(inputs.committee_notes, align=\"justify\")\n\n # ---- 7 recommendations -----------------------------------------------------------\n rb.heading(\"7. Recommendations\", 1)\n recs = [\n (\"Protect the wellhead: keep the 30 m sanitary zone free of latrines, \"\n \"refuse pits and animal pens.\"),\n (\"Keep this report and the borehole data sheet with the committee \"\n \"records; any future contractor will need them.\"),\n (\"Report persistent taste, odour or discolouration to the district \"\n \"water office and arrange a water quality test.\"),\n ]\n state = inputs.quality.verdict_state if inputs.quality is not None else None\n if state in (\"health_fail\", \"national_fail\"):\n recs.insert(\n 0,\n \"Implement the treatment measures in the water quality report \"\n \"before the water is used for drinking.\",\n )\n elif state == \"indeterminate\":\n recs.insert(\n 0,\n \"Do not describe this supply as safe to drink until the water \"\n \"quality results are complete: \"\n + \"; \".join(inputs.quality.uncertainties)\n + \".\",\n )\n if (\n inputs.quality is not None\n and inputs.quality.corrosivity is not None\n and inputs.quality.corrosivity.is_aggressive\n ):\n recs.insert(0, inputs.quality.corrosivity.materials_note)\n recs.extend(inputs.extra_recommendations)\n rb.bullets(recs)\n\n # ---- references and glossary -----------------------------------------------\n rb.references(references_for(\"handover\"))\n rb.glossary(GLOSSARY)\n\n # ---- signatures ----------------------------------------------------------------------\n rb.heading(\"8. Handover Signatures\", 1)\n rb.paragraph(\n \"The works described above are handed over to the client and the \"\n \"community in working condition.\"\n )\n for role, name in (\n (\"For the contractor\", inputs.contractor_rep or site.contractor),\n (\"For the client\", inputs.client_rep or site.client),\n (\"For the community / WASH committee\", inputs.community_rep),\n ):\n rb.paragraph(\"\")\n rb.paragraph(\".\" * 30)\n rb.paragraph(f\"{role}: {name}\", bold=True)\n rb.paragraph(\"Date: ........................\")\n\n return rb.save(out_path)\n\n\ndef _executive_summary(inputs: HandoverReportInputs) -> tuple[list[str], list[str]]:\n \"\"\"Compose the handover executive summary from the assembled results.\"\"\"\n site = inputs.site\n community = site.community or \"the water point\"\n log = inputs.log\n analysis = inputs.pumping\n yr = analysis.yield_recommendation if analysis else None\n quality = inputs.quality\n\n bits = [\n f\"This report hands over the completed borehole water supply at \"\n f\"{community}\" + (f\", {site.district} District\" if site.district else \"\") + \".\"\n ]\n if log is not None and log.total_depth_m:\n s = f\"The borehole was drilled to {fmt_num(log.total_depth_m)} m\"\n if log.status:\n s += f\" and is recorded as {log.status.lower()}\"\n bits.append(s + \".\")\n if yr is not None and yr.safe_yield_m3_per_h:\n bits.append(\n f\"The recommended safe yield is {fmt_num(yr.safe_yield_m3_per_h)} m3/h.\"\n )\n if yr.is_indicative:\n bits.append(yr.confidence_text)\n if quality is not None:\n # Chosen on the full verdict state, not the health exceedances alone:\n # a national breach or an unevaluable panel used to read as suitable.\n sentence = SUITABILITY_SENTENCE[quality.verdict_state]\n if quality.verdict_state in (\"health_fail\", \"national_fail\"):\n sentence = sentence.rstrip(\".\") + \"; see the water quality section.\"\n bits.append(sentence)\n\n key: list[str] = []\n if log is not None and log.total_depth_m:\n key.append(\n f\"Borehole depth: {fmt_num(log.total_depth_m)} m\"\n + (f\", {log.status}.\" if log.status else \".\")\n )\n if yr is not None and yr.safe_yield_m3_per_h:\n key.append(\n f\"Safe yield: {fmt_num(yr.safe_yield_m3_per_h)} m3/h\"\n + (\" (indicative)\" if yr.is_indicative else \"\") + \".\"\n )\n if quality is not None:\n key.append(\"Water safety: \" + SUITABILITY_PHRASE[quality.verdict_state])\n key.append(\n \"Keep this report with the WASH committee records and maintain the \"\n \"sanitary protection zone around the wellhead.\"\n )\n return [\" \".join(bits)], key\n\n\ndef default_works(inputs: HandoverReportInputs) -> list[str]:\n \"\"\"The works list, built only from what the project actually holds.\n\n This document is signed by the contractor, the client and the\n community, so it must not assert a pumping test or a laboratory\n analysis that nobody supplied. Each bullet is conditioned on the object\n that evidences it; ``works_completed`` remains the explicit override.\n\n It is also why a bullet names its method and carries its quantity: an\n interim payment is argued from this list, and what a quantity surveyor\n checks is the drilled depth, the screen run and the seal. \"Cased and\n screened\" is not a figure anybody can measure against.\n\n The browser writes the same list in ``docs/js/gwt-docx.js`` and\n ``tests/webapp/parity.mjs`` holds the two to the same words, so a\n reworded bullet here is a reworded bullet there. They used to differ in\n four of seven bullets, which handed one borehole two different\n certificates: a surveyor got the casing size or the screen run, never\n both, and never the seal.\n \"\"\"\n works = []\n if inputs.sited:\n works.append(\"Geophysical siting survey and borehole location selection.\")\n log = inputs.log\n # The depth is the first quantity anyone measures the claim against, so\n # the bullet waits for one rather than certifying a borehole drilled to\n # \"n/a\" off a sheet where nobody wrote the depth down.\n if log is not None and log.total_depth_m is not None:\n works.append(\n f\"Drilling of the borehole to {fmt_num(log.total_depth_m)} m\"\n + (f\" by {log.drilling_method}\" if log.drilling_method else \"\")\n + \".\"\n )\n design = inputs.design\n if design is not None:\n works.append(\n f\"Construction with {design.casing_diameter_in:g} inch \"\n f\"{design.casing_material} casing, \"\n f\"{fmt_num(design.total_screen_length_m)} m of screen, gravel pack \"\n f\"and sanitary seal to {fmt_num(design.sanitary_seal[1])} m.\"\n )\n works.append(\"Development of the borehole by air lifting until clear.\")\n if inputs.pumping is not None:\n works.append(\"Pumping test and yield assessment.\")\n if inputs.quality is not None:\n works.append(\"Water quality sampling and laboratory analysis.\")\n # No wellhead bullet. This used to be appended unconditionally, which made\n # the docstring above false in its own function: the toolkit holds no\n # headworks record of any kind, so there was nothing for it to be\n # conditioned on and the list certified an apron and a drainage channel on\n # every borehole - including one whose only input was a drilling log. A\n # supervisor who built them says so through ``works_completed``, which is\n # what that field is for.\n return works\n"}, "groundwater/reporting/procurement.py": {"t": "text", "d": "\"\"\"The interim payment certificate.\n\nThe document a contractor is paid against, so everything that reduces the\npayment appears on its face with its own line: what was authorised, what was\nmeasured, what the difference is, and every deduction between the value of\nthe work and the figure at the bottom. A certificate that shows only the\nbottom figure is one nobody can check, and one nobody can check is one\nnobody can dispute.\n\nWhere the valuation found a problem it is printed before the money rather\nthan after it. The certificate is still issued - work has been done and the\ncontractor has to be paid for it - but the person signing sees first what\nthe figure below rests on.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\nfrom typing import Any\n\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom ..config import Config\nfrom ..models import SiteMetadata\nfrom ..procurement import Certificate, Contract, contract_summary\nfrom .context import _figures_dir, add_area_section\nfrom .docx_utils import ReportBuilder\n\n__all__ = [\"PaymentCertificateInputs\", \"build_payment_certificate\"]\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass PaymentCertificateInputs:\n contract: Contract\n certificate: Certificate\n prepared_by: str = \"\"\n prepared_role: str = \"Supervising engineer\"\n readiness: Any = None\n #: The works being paid for are at a place. Supply the site and the\n #: certificate carries a map of it; the figures go beside the document\n #: unless a directory is named.\n site: SiteMetadata | None = None\n figures_dir: Path | None = None\n\n\ndef build_payment_certificate(inputs: PaymentCertificateInputs,\n out_path, config: Config | None = None):\n contract = inputs.contract\n certificate = inputs.certificate\n rb = ReportBuilder(config.style if config else None,\n title=f\"Interim Payment Certificate {certificate.number}\")\n\n rb.cover(\n [f\"Interim Payment Certificate No. {certificate.number}\"],\n [contract.ref, contract.contractor or \"\"],\n [(\"Date\", certificate.date),\n (\"Due on this certificate\", f\"${certificate.due_now_usd:,.0f}\")],\n )\n rb.provisional_stamp(inputs.readiness)\n\n if certificate.problems:\n rb.heading(\"Before the figures\")\n rb.paragraph(\n \"The valuation below could not be made cleanly. Each item here \"\n \"reduces or holds back money, and the certificate is issued with \"\n \"them showing rather than resolved silently.\", bold=True)\n rb.bullets(certificate.problems)\n\n if inputs.site is not None:\n add_area_section(rb, inputs.site,\n _figures_dir(inputs.figures_dir, out_path),\n config.style if config else None,\n heading=\"Where the works are\")\n\n rb.heading(\"Summary\")\n rb.table([[label, value] for label, value in\n contract_summary(contract, certificate)],\n header=[\"\", \"\"], col_widths_cm=[8.0, 7.0])\n if certificate.overpaid_usd:\n rb.paragraph(\n f\"Certificates already issued exceed the value of the work by \"\n f\"${certificate.overpaid_usd:,.0f}. Nothing is due on this \"\n \"certificate. Recovering the difference is a credit note to be \"\n \"agreed, not a negative payment.\", bold=True)\n\n rb.heading(\"Measurement\")\n rb.table(\n [[line.code, line.item, line.unit,\n f\"{line.contract_quantity:g}\",\n f\"{line.variation_quantity:+g}\" if line.variation_quantity else \"-\",\n f\"{line.measured_quantity:g}\",\n f\"{line.payable_quantity:g}\",\n f\"{line.rate_usd:,.2f}\",\n f\"{line.payable_amount_usd:,.0f}\"]\n for line in certificate.lines],\n header=[\"Code\", \"Item\", \"Unit\", \"Contract\", \"Varied\", \"Measured\",\n \"Payable\", \"Rate (USD)\", \"Amount (USD)\"],\n caption=\"Work measured to date and what is payable on it\",\n col_widths_cm=[1.6, 4.2, 1.2, 1.6, 1.4, 1.6, 1.5, 1.6, 1.8],\n font_size_pt=8.5,\n )\n\n overmeasured = [line for line in certificate.lines\n if line.overmeasure_quantity > 0]\n if overmeasured:\n rb.heading(\"Measured beyond what was authorised\")\n rb.paragraph(\n \"The quantities below have been done but not authorised, so they \"\n \"are not certified here. That is not a judgement on whether the \"\n \"work was necessary - it usually was - but on whether anybody has \"\n \"yet signed for it. A variation order authorising them makes them \"\n \"payable on the next certificate.\", align=\"justify\")\n rb.table(\n [[line.code, line.item,\n f\"{line.authorised_quantity:g} {line.unit}\",\n f\"{line.measured_quantity:g} {line.unit}\",\n f\"{line.overmeasure_quantity:g} {line.unit}\",\n f\"{line.overmeasure_amount_usd:,.0f}\"]\n for line in overmeasured],\n header=[\"Code\", \"Item\", \"Authorised\", \"Measured\", \"Excess\",\n \"Value withheld (USD)\"],\n col_widths_cm=[1.8, 4.6, 2.4, 2.4, 2.0, 2.4],\n )\n rb.paragraph(\n f\"Total value measured but not certified: \"\n f\"${certificate.overmeasure_usd:,.0f}.\", bold=True)\n\n varied = [line for line in certificate.lines if line.variation_refs]\n if varied:\n rb.heading(\"Variations included\")\n rb.table(\n [[\", \".join(line.variation_refs), line.code, line.item,\n f\"{line.variation_quantity:+g} {line.unit}\",\n f\"{line.authorised_amount_usd - line.contract_amount_usd:+,.0f}\"]\n for line in varied],\n header=[\"Reference\", \"Code\", \"Item\", \"Quantity\", \"Value (USD)\"],\n col_widths_cm=[2.4, 1.8, 5.6, 2.6, 3.2],\n )\n\n rb.heading(\"Certification\")\n rb.paragraph(\n f\"The work described above has been measured and valued at \"\n f\"${certificate.gross_usd:,.0f}. After retention and previous \"\n f\"certificates, ${certificate.due_now_usd:,.0f} is due to \"\n f\"{contract.contractor or 'the contractor'} on this certificate.\")\n rb.signature_block(\n name=inputs.prepared_by, role=inputs.prepared_role,\n organisation=(config.style.organisation if config else \"\"),\n )\n return rb.save(out_path)\n"}, "groundwater/reporting/pumping.py": {"t": "text", "d": "\"\"\"Pumping test report generator.\n\nCovers the test details, data quality notes, diagnostic plots, the\naquifer parameters from every applicable method, and the safe yield\nrecommendation with its full basis. When discharge is missing the\nreport still carries the drawdown and recovery curves, the stabilised\nlevel and available drawdown, with transmissivity and yield stated as\npending.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom typing import Any\n\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\n\nfrom ..config import Config\nfrom ..hydraulics.analysis import (\n METHOD_LABELS,\n TWO_POINT_NOTE,\n PumpingTestAnalysis,\n pump_intake_depth,\n test_type_text,\n)\nfrom ..hydraulics.plots import (\n plot_cooper_jacob,\n plot_recovery,\n plot_step_test,\n plot_test_overview,\n plot_theis,\n)\nfrom ..seasonal import MONTH_NAMES\nfrom ..utils import fmt_num, safe_slug\nfrom .citations import GLOSSARY, references_for\nfrom .docx_utils import ReportBuilder\nfrom .context import add_area_section\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass PumpingReportInputs:\n analysis: PumpingTestAnalysis\n figures_dir: Path\n analyst_name: str = \"\"\n analyst_role: str = \"Hydrogeologist\"\n analyst_phone: str = \"\"\n include_qa_section: bool = True\n #: The certification gate for this report, from\n #: :func:`groundwater.readiness.assess_readiness`. When it is not\n #: certifiable the cover says so; when it is absent nothing is\n #: stamped, so an existing caller is unaffected.\n readiness: Any = None\n #: The seasonal projection from :func:`groundwater.seasonal.seasonal_yield`.\n #: Absent, section 5 reports the single figure as before.\n seasonal: Any = None\n\n\n#: Flags that say the recorded levels cannot all be right. A report used to\n#: certify \"the drawdown and recovery curves are valid\" over levels 18 m\n#: below the pump intake.\nLEVEL_FLAGS = (\"water_level_above_static\", \"level_below_borehole\", \"level_below_pump\")\n\n#: Where the levels are measured from. The sheets record depth to water from\n#: the top of the casing and never the casing's stick-up above ground, so\n#: \"below ground level\" was a claim the data did not support.\nDATUM_TEXT = \"below the top of the casing, the datum the levels were measured from\"\n\n\ndef _levels_in_doubt(analysis: PumpingTestAnalysis) -> bool:\n codes = {f.code for f in analysis.flags} | {f.code for f in analysis.test.flags}\n return bool(codes & set(LEVEL_FLAGS))\n\n\ndef _executive_summary(analysis: PumpingTestAnalysis,\n seasonal=None) -> tuple[list[str], list[str]]:\n \"\"\"Compose the pumping-test executive summary from the analysis.\"\"\"\n test = analysis.test\n community = test.site.community or \"the site\"\n test_name = test_type_text(test.test_type)\n yr = analysis.yield_recommendation\n t = analysis.transmissivity_m2_per_day\n if yr is not None and yr.safe_yield_m3_per_h:\n depth, why = pump_intake_depth(analysis, seasonal)\n para = (\n f\"A {test_name} was carried out on the borehole at \"\n f\"{community}. The recommended safe yield is \"\n f\"{fmt_num(yr.safe_yield_m3_per_h)} m3/h (safety factor \"\n f\"{yr.safety_factor:g} applied to the long term yield), with the \"\n f\"pump intake set at {fmt_num(depth)} m {DATUM_TEXT}\"\n + (f\", {why}\" if why else \"\") + \".\"\n )\n if yr.is_indicative:\n para += \" \" + yr.confidence_text\n key = [\n f\"Transmissivity: {fmt_num(t)} m2/day\"\n + (f\" ({METHOD_LABELS[analysis.transmissivity_source]})\"\n if analysis.transmissivity_source else \"\") + \".\" if t else \"\",\n f\"Recommended safe yield: {yr.yield_range_text}\"\n + (\" (indicative)\" if yr.is_indicative else \"\") + \".\",\n f\"Pump installation depth: {fmt_num(depth)} m.\",\n (f\"Confidence: indicative - {yr.confidence_reasons[0]}.\"\n if yr.is_indicative else \"Confidence: established.\"),\n \"Operate within the recommended rate and monitor the pumping level.\",\n ]\n else:\n # the recommendation names what stopped it; a blank used to be\n # blamed on the discharge whether or not it was on the sheet\n reason = (yr.pending_reason if yr and yr.pending_reason\n else \"the analysis is incomplete\")\n curves = (\n \"The recorded water levels are inconsistent with the stated static \"\n \"level, pump setting or borehole depth (see the data verification \"\n \"notes), so the curves are shown as recorded and their drawdowns \"\n \"are not to be relied on; the\"\n if _levels_in_doubt(analysis)\n else \"The drawdown and recovery curves are plotted from the readings \"\n \"as recorded, but the\"\n )\n para = (\n f\"A {test_name} was carried out on the borehole at \"\n f\"{community}. {curves} transmissivity and safe yield are pending \"\n \"because \" + reason + \".\"\n )\n key = [\n f\"Stabilised water level: {fmt_num(analysis.stabilised_level_m)} m.\"\n if analysis.stabilised_level_m is not None else \"\",\n f\"Yield recommendation pending: {reason}.\",\n ]\n return [para], key\n\n\ndef _not_adopted(rb, analysis: PumpingTestAnalysis, method: str) -> None:\n \"\"\"One bold sentence under a method's paragraph when its T is passed over.\"\"\"\n why = analysis.why_not_adopted(method)\n _, _, qualifies = analysis.adopted_fit()\n if not why:\n return\n if analysis.transmissivity_source == method and not qualifies:\n rb.paragraph(\n f\"Adopted as the best available, not because it meets the standard: \"\n f\"{why}.\", bold=True)\n else:\n rb.paragraph(f\"Not adopted for the yield: {why}.\", bold=True)\n\n\ndef build_pumping_report(\n inputs: PumpingReportInputs,\n out_path: str | Path,\n config: Config | None = None,\n) -> Path:\n config = config or Config()\n analysis = inputs.analysis\n test = analysis.test\n site = test.site\n figures = Path(inputs.figures_dir)\n # Qualify figure filenames with the borehole: several reports share one\n # figures directory in an app session, and generation is guarded by an\n # existence check, so fixed names made the second report silently embed\n # the first borehole's curves.\n slug = safe_slug(test.borehole_ref or test.site.community, \"bh\")\n figures.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n\n rb = ReportBuilder(config.style, title=f\"Pumping Test Report - {site.community}\")\n rb.cover(\n title_lines=[\"PUMPING TEST REPORT\"],\n subtitle_lines=[\n test_type_text(test.test_type).capitalize(),\n f\"at {site.community}\" + (f\", {site.district} District\" if site.district else \"\"),\n ],\n details=[\n (\"Client\", site.client),\n (\"Borehole\", test.borehole_ref or \"n/a\"),\n (\"Test date\", site.date),\n (\"Conducted by\", site.supervisor),\n ],\n )\n rb.provisional_stamp(inputs.readiness)\n\n # ---- executive summary ------------------------------------------------\n seasonal = inputs.seasonal\n exec_paras, exec_key = _executive_summary(analysis, seasonal)\n rb.executive_summary(exec_paras, exec_key)\n pump_depth, pump_depth_why = pump_intake_depth(analysis, seasonal)\n\n # ---- 1 test details ---------------------------------------------------\n rb.heading(\"1. Test Details\", 1)\n rb.header_block_table(\n [\n (\"Community\", site.community), (\"Client\", site.client),\n (\"Borehole Ref. No.\", test.borehole_ref or \"\"), (\"Date\", site.date),\n (\"Test type\", test_type_text(test.test_type)), (\"Conducted by\", site.supervisor),\n (\"Depth of borehole\", fmt_num(test.borehole_depth_m) + \" m\" if test.borehole_depth_m else \"\"),\n (\"Static water level\", fmt_num(test.static_water_level_m) + \" m\"\n if test.static_water_level_m is not None else \"\"),\n (\"Pump setting during test\", fmt_num(test.pump_setting_m) + \" m\"\n if test.pump_setting_m else \"not recorded\"),\n (\"Pumping duration\", fmt_num(test.pumping_duration_min) + \" min\"\n if test.pumping_duration_min else \"\"),\n (\"Length of each step\", fmt_num(test.step_length_min) + \" min\" if test.step_length_min else \"\"),\n ]\n )\n rb.paragraph(\n \"Water levels are depths below the top of the casing, the datum the \"\n \"field sheet records them from; the casing's stick-up above ground is \"\n \"not recorded, so every depth in this report is to that datum.\",\n italic=True,\n )\n discharges = \", \".join(\n f\"{s.label}: \" + (f\"{s.discharge_m3_per_h:g} m3/h\" if s.discharge_m3_per_h else \"not recorded\")\n for s in test.steps\n )\n rb.paragraph(f\"Discharge rates: {discharges}.\")\n if not test.has_discharge:\n rb.paragraph(\n \"The discharge rate was not recorded on the field sheet. The \"\n \"drawdown and recovery curves below remain valid; transmissivity \"\n \"and yield results are pending until the discharge is supplied.\",\n bold=True,\n )\n\n add_area_section(rb, site, figures, config.style,\n heading=\"1.1 Location and setting\")\n\n # ---- 2 data ------------------------------------------------------------\n rb.heading(\"2. Field Data\", 1)\n rb.paragraph(\n \"True drawdown is computed as the measured water level minus the \"\n \"static water level. Reading intervals are irregular and are handled as \"\n \"recorded.\",\n align=\"justify\",\n )\n overview_path = figures / f\"test_overview_{slug}.png\"\n plot_test_overview(test, path=overview_path, style=config.style)\n fig_no = rb.figure(overview_path, \"Water level record for the full test including recovery.\")\n if analysis.stabilised_level_m is not None:\n rb.paragraph(\n f\"The pumped water level stabilised at about \"\n f\"{fmt_num(analysis.stabilised_level_m)} m (Figure {fig_no}).\"\n )\n if analysis.max_drawdown_m is not None:\n rb.paragraph(\n f\"The maximum drawdown reached {fmt_num(analysis.max_drawdown_m)} m \"\n \"below the static water level\"\n + (\", as recorded; the notes below say why the recorded levels \"\n \"cannot all be right\" if _levels_in_doubt(analysis) else \"\")\n + \".\"\n )\n if analysis.casing_storage_min:\n rb.paragraph(\n f\"Casing storage: with a {config.pumping.casing_diameter_in:g} inch \"\n \"casing and the specific capacity at the end of the first step, the \"\n \"water standing in the casing supplies the pump for about the first \"\n f\"{analysis.casing_storage_min:.0f} minutes (Schafer's rule). Drawdown \"\n \"inside that period is the borehole emptying, not the aquifer \"\n \"responding, and no straight line is read from it.\",\n align=\"justify\",\n )\n if inputs.include_qa_section and analysis.flags:\n rb.paragraph(\"Data verification notes:\", bold=True)\n rb.bullets([str(f) for f in analysis.flags])\n\n # ---- 3 analysis ----------------------------------------------------------\n rb.heading(\"3. Analysis\", 1)\n swl = test.static_water_level_m\n section = 0\n\n if analysis.cooper_jacob is not None:\n section += 1\n cj = analysis.cooper_jacob\n rb.heading(f\"3.{section} Cooper-Jacob straight line method\", 2)\n step = test.steps[0]\n t = step.time_min\n s = step.water_level_m - swl\n cj_path = figures / f\"cooper_jacob_{slug}.png\"\n plot_cooper_jacob(t, s, cj, path=cj_path, style=config.style)\n rb.figure(cj_path, \"Drawdown against log time with the fitted straight line.\")\n rb.paragraph(\n f\"The late time slope is {fmt_num(cj.slope_m_per_log_cycle)} m per \"\n f\"log cycle over {cj.n_points} readings \"\n f\"(R squared {cj.r_squared:.3f}), giving a transmissivity of \"\n f\"{fmt_num(cj.transmissivity_m2_per_day)} m2/day at a discharge of \"\n f\"{fmt_num(cj.discharge_m3_per_h)} m3/h. {cj.u_check}.\",\n align=\"justify\",\n )\n _not_adopted(rb, analysis, \"cooper_jacob\")\n if cj.storativity is not None:\n rb.paragraph(\n f\"Storativity from the zero drawdown intercept: \"\n f\"{cj.storativity:.2e} (observation well data).\"\n )\n\n if analysis.theis is not None:\n section += 1\n th = analysis.theis\n rb.heading(f\"3.{section} Theis type curve fit\", 2)\n step = test.steps[0]\n theis_path = figures / f\"theis_fit_{slug}.png\"\n plot_theis(step.time_min, step.water_level_m - swl, th, path=theis_path, style=config.style)\n rb.figure(theis_path, \"Log-log drawdown with the fitted Theis curve.\")\n s_note = \"\" if th.storativity_reliable else (\n \" In a single pumped well storativity trades off against the \"\n \"effective well radius, so the fitted S is indicative only.\"\n )\n rb.paragraph(\n f\"Least squares fitting of the Theis well function gives \"\n f\"T = {fmt_num(th.transmissivity_m2_per_day)} m2/day and \"\n f\"S = {th.storativity:.1e} (RMSE {fmt_num(th.rmse_m)} m).{s_note}\",\n align=\"justify\",\n )\n _not_adopted(rb, analysis, \"theis\")\n\n if analysis.recovery is not None:\n section += 1\n rec = analysis.recovery\n rb.heading(f\"3.{section} Theis recovery method\", 2)\n rec_path = figures / f\"recovery_{slug}.png\"\n plot_recovery(\n test.recovery_time_min, test.residual_drawdown(),\n rec.pumping_time_min, rec, path=rec_path, style=config.style,\n )\n rb.figure(rec_path, \"Residual drawdown against t/t', with the fitted line \"\n \"and where it meets t/t' = 1.\")\n time_text = (\n f\"an equivalent pumping time of {rec.pumping_time_min:.0f} minutes at \"\n f\"the last rate of {fmt_num(rec.discharge_m3_per_h)} m3/h (the volume \"\n \"pumped over all the steps, at that rate)\"\n if rec.equivalent_time\n else f\"the {rec.pumping_time_min:g} minutes pumped\"\n )\n rb.paragraph(\n f\"With t/t' formed from {time_text}, the recovery slope is \"\n f\"{fmt_num(rec.slope_m_per_log_cycle)} m per log cycle (R squared \"\n f\"{rec.r_squared:.3f}), giving T = {fmt_num(rec.transmissivity_m2_per_day)} \"\n f\"m2/day. The fitted line meets t/t' = 1 at {fmt_num(rec.intercept_m)} m \"\n \"of residual drawdown, where the method requires zero. Residual \"\n f\"drawdown at the end of monitoring was {fmt_num(rec.residual_at_end_m)} m.\"\n + (\"\" if analysis.why_not_adopted(\"recovery\") else\n \" Recovery derived transmissivity is generally the most reliable \"\n \"single well estimate because it is unaffected by pumping rate \"\n \"fluctuations and well losses.\"),\n align=\"justify\",\n )\n _not_adopted(rb, analysis, \"recovery\")\n\n if analysis.step_test is not None:\n section += 1\n st = analysis.step_test\n rb.heading(f\"3.{section} Step drawdown analysis (Hantush-Bierschenk)\", 2)\n st_path = figures / f\"step_test_{slug}.png\"\n plot_step_test(test, st, path=st_path, style=config.style)\n rb.figure(st_path, \"Step drawdown data and the specific drawdown fit.\")\n # a refit with a coefficient pinned at zero has no efficiency to\n # report; 0% or 100% printed as a borehole's efficiency is a number\n # nobody should act on\n rows = [\n [s[\"step\"], fmt_num(s[\"discharge_m3_per_h\"]), fmt_num(s[\"drawdown_end_m\"]),\n fmt_num(s[\"sw_over_q_day_per_m2\"], 3),\n \"n/a\" if st.fit_note else f\"{s['efficiency_percent']:.0f}%\"\n + (\" (indicative)\" if st.two_point else \"\")]\n for s in st.steps\n ]\n rb.table(\n rows,\n header=[\"Step\", \"Q (m3/h)\", \"End drawdown (m)\", \"s/Q (day/m2)\", \"Efficiency\"],\n caption=\"Step test summary and well efficiency.\",\n )\n rb.paragraph(\n f\"The drawdown-discharge relationship is s = BQ + CQ2 with \"\n f\"B = {st.aquifer_loss_B:.3e} day/m2 (aquifer loss) and \"\n f\"C = {st.well_loss_C:.3e} day2/m5 (well loss)\"\n + (f\", fitted through {len(st.steps)} points. {TWO_POINT_NOTE}.\"\n if st.two_point\n else f\", fitted with R squared {st.r_squared:.3f}.\")\n + (f\" Note: {st.fit_note}.\" if st.fit_note else \"\"),\n align=\"justify\",\n )\n elif test.test_type.startswith(\"step\") and not test.has_discharge:\n section += 1\n rb.heading(f\"3.{section} Step drawdown analysis\", 2)\n step_path = figures / f\"step_test_{slug}.png\"\n plot_step_test(test, None, path=step_path, style=config.style)\n rb.figure(step_path, \"Step drawdown curves (discharge pending).\")\n rb.paragraph(\n \"Hantush-Bierschenk analysis is pending until the discharge of \"\n \"each step is supplied.\",\n )\n\n # ---- 4 results summary ------------------------------------------------\n rb.heading(\"4. Results Summary\", 1)\n source = analysis.transmissivity_source\n _, _, qualifies = analysis.adopted_fit()\n rows = []\n for key in (\"cooper_jacob\", \"theis\", \"recovery\"):\n result = getattr(analysis, key)\n if result is not None:\n if key == source:\n status = (\"adopted\" if qualifies\n else \"adopted as the best available; \"\n + analysis.why_not_adopted(key))\n else:\n status = analysis.why_not_adopted(key) or \"not adopted\"\n rows.append([\n METHOD_LABELS[key],\n fmt_num(result.transmissivity_m2_per_day),\n status[0].upper() + status[1:],\n ])\n if rows:\n rb.table(rows, header=[\"Method\", \"Transmissivity (m2/day)\", \"Status\"],\n caption=\"Transmissivity estimates and what each is worth.\")\n else:\n rb.paragraph(\"Transmissivity: pending (discharge not recorded).\", bold=True)\n yr = analysis.yield_recommendation\n if yr is not None:\n summary_rows = [\n [\"Transmissivity adopted for the yield\",\n f\"{fmt_num(analysis.transmissivity_m2_per_day)} m2/day \"\n f\"({METHOD_LABELS[source]})\" if source else \"pending\"],\n [\"Specific capacity\",\n f\"{yr.specific_capacity_m3hr_per_m:.2g} m3/h per m \"\n f\"({yr.specific_capacity_basis})\"\n if yr.specific_capacity_m3hr_per_m else \"pending\"],\n [\"Available drawdown\", fmt_num(yr.available_drawdown_m) + \" m\"\n if yr.available_drawdown_m else \"n/a\"],\n [\"Usable drawdown\", fmt_num(yr.usable_drawdown_m) + \" m\"\n if yr.usable_drawdown_m else \"n/a\"],\n [\"Long term yield\", fmt_num(yr.long_term_yield_m3_per_h) + \" m3/h\"\n if yr.long_term_yield_m3_per_h else \"pending\"],\n [f\"Recommended safe yield (safety factor {yr.safety_factor:g})\",\n yr.yield_range_text],\n [\"Confidence\", (\"indicative\" if yr.is_indicative else \"established\")\n if yr.safe_yield_m3_per_h else \"pending\"],\n [\"Recommended pump installation depth\",\n fmt_num(pump_depth) + \" m\" + (f\", {pump_depth_why}\" if pump_depth_why else \"\")\n if pump_depth else \"pending\"],\n [\"Pump setting during the test\",\n fmt_num(test.pump_setting_m) + \" m\" if test.pump_setting_m else \"not recorded\"],\n ]\n rb.table(summary_rows, header=[\"Quantity\", \"Value\"], caption=\"Yield summary.\")\n\n # ---- 5 recommendation ----------------------------------------------------\n rb.heading(\"5. Yield Recommendation\", 1)\n if yr is not None:\n rb.paragraph(yr.basis, align=\"justify\")\n if yr.envelope_basis:\n rb.paragraph(yr.envelope_basis, align=\"justify\")\n if yr.pump_depth_basis:\n rb.paragraph(yr.pump_depth_basis, align=\"justify\")\n if yr.safe_yield_m3_per_h:\n rb.paragraph(yr.confidence_text, align=\"justify\", bold=yr.is_indicative)\n rb.bullets(\n [\n (f\"Operate the borehole at no more than \"\n f\"{fmt_num(yr.safe_yield_m3_per_h)} m3/h\"\n + (\" (indicative; see above)\" if yr.is_indicative else \"\") + \".\"),\n (f\"Install the pump intake at {fmt_num(pump_depth)} m \"\n f\"{DATUM_TEXT}\" + (f\", {pump_depth_why}\" if pump_depth_why else \"\")\n + \", in plain casing: where that depth falls within a screen, \"\n \"the borehole design sets it just below that screen.\"),\n (\"Monitor the pumping water level and re-assess the yield if \"\n \"the level approaches the pump intake.\"),\n ]\n )\n\n if seasonal is not None and seasonal.is_established:\n rb.heading(\"5.1 Through the year\", 2)\n rb.paragraph(\n \"A pumping test measures one day. The borehole has to supply the \"\n \"village on the worst day, and those are months apart: the water \"\n \"table is recharged through the single wet season, peaks at the \"\n \"end of it and falls through the dry season to an annual low in \"\n \"April or May. The same test therefore means different things \"\n \"depending on when it was run, so the yield is reported here at \"\n \"each of three water levels rather than at one.\",\n align=\"justify\")\n if seasonal.month:\n rb.paragraph(\n f\"This test was run in {MONTH_NAMES[seasonal.month - 1]}, the \"\n f\"{seasonal.season}.\")\n elif seasonal.month_note:\n rb.paragraph(\n seasonal.month_note + \" The whole annual range is therefore \"\n \"reserved, which is the conservative reading.\", bold=True)\n rb.table(\n [[s.title, f\"{s.decline_m:.1f}\",\n fmt_num(s.static_water_level_m), fmt_num(s.available_drawdown_m),\n fmt_num(s.safe_yield_m3_per_h),\n fmt_num(s.pump_installation_depth_m)]\n for s in seasonal.scenarios],\n header=[\"Scenario\", \"Further decline (m)\", \"Static level (m)\",\n \"Available drawdown (m)\", \"Safe yield (m3/h)\",\n \"Pump intake (m)\"],\n caption=\"Safe yield and pump setting at each seasonal water level\",\n )\n rb.paragraph(\n f\"The annual range used is {seasonal.annual_range_m:.1f} m - \"\n f\"{seasonal.range_source}. It is the one number here that a single \"\n \"test cannot measure, and every figure in the table moves with it.\",\n italic=True)\n loss = seasonal.dry_season_loss_percent\n if loss and loss > 1:\n rb.paragraph(\n f\"By the end of the dry season the borehole yields about \"\n f\"{loss:.0f}% less than it did on the day of the test.\",\n bold=True)\n if any(s.safe_yield_m3_per_h is None for s in seasonal.scenarios):\n # a blank cell in the table is not a finding; the summary says\n # in words that the pump would be dry in that scenario\n rb.paragraph(seasonal.summary, bold=True)\n rb.bullets([s.note for s in seasonal.scenarios])\n if pump_depth is not None:\n rb.paragraph(\n f\"The pump intake recommended above, {fmt_num(pump_depth)} m \"\n f\"{DATUM_TEXT}, is set for the drought case: the pump is fitted \"\n \"once, and one that draws air in a bad year loses the village its \"\n \"borehole in the year it is needed most.\",\n bold=True)\n\n # ---- limitations -----------------------------------------------------------\n rb.heading(\"6. Limitations and Uncertainty\", 1)\n rb.bullets(\n [\n (\"The analysis assumes a homogeneous, isotropic aquifer of large \"\n \"extent. A barrier or a recharge (stream or coast) boundary, if \"\n \"present, changes the late-time drawdown slope and would bias the \"\n \"transmissivity.\"),\n (\"In a single pumped well the storativity trades off against the \"\n \"effective well radius, so any storativity reported from this test \"\n \"is indicative only.\"),\n (\"The safe yield is projected to the design period from a short \"\n \"test; it should be confirmed by monitoring the pumping water \"\n \"level once the borehole is in service.\"\n if not (yr is not None and yr.is_indicative) else\n \"The yield is indicative, not established: \"\n + \"; \".join(yr.confidence_reasons)\n + \". It should be confirmed by a test of at least \"\n f\"{config.pumping.min_constant_test_min:g} minutes, or by monitoring \"\n \"the pumping water level once the borehole is in service.\"),\n # Section 5.1 exists only when a seasonal projection was supplied;\n # the bullet used to cite it in every report regardless\n (\n \"Yield varies with the season. Section 5.1 projects the tested \"\n \"level to the annual low and to a drought year, but the size of \"\n \"the annual swing is assumed rather than measured; two water-level \"\n \"readings a year apart in this borehole would replace that \"\n \"assumption with a number.\"\n if seasonal is not None and seasonal.is_established\n else \"Yield varies with the season. This report gives the yield at \"\n \"the water level measured on the day of the test; no seasonal \"\n \"projection was supplied, so the dry-season and drought-year \"\n \"figures are not given. Two water-level readings a year apart in \"\n \"this borehole would allow that projection.\"\n ),\n ]\n )\n\n # ---- references and glossary -----------------------------------------------\n rb.references(references_for(\"pumping\"))\n rb.glossary(GLOSSARY)\n\n rb.signature_block(\n name=inputs.analyst_name or site.supervisor,\n role=inputs.analyst_role,\n phone=inputs.analyst_phone,\n
